1601101.title: Not All Movies Are the Same: Dual

1601186.synopsis: White Rock brings together scientists, Traditional Owners, fishers and policymakers to expose one of the biggest environmental challenges facing our oceans: the explosion of long-spined sea urchins devastating Australia's kelp forests.
1601186.title: White Rock

1601195.synopsis: Facing a world gone sideways, comedy icon Dave Chappelle delivers bold truths and potent punchlines in this no-holds-barred special.
1601195.title: Dave Chappelle: The Unstoppable...

1601672.synopsis: A group of young men waltz in pairs, balancing with a glass between their foreheads. In this captivating setting, director Albert Rask crafts a new code of conduct - an allegory reflecting the experience of growing up. A playful yet poignant exploration that reframes the burdens of responsibility, expectations and the rules of adulthood.
1601672.title: My Name Is The Sound I Use To Introduce Myself

1601683.synopsis: A getaway game of truth or dare leads four friends to swap partners, risking everything to reignite passion and save their marriages.
1601683.title: Switch

1601724.synopsis: The rural NSW town of Trundle attempts to hold the world's first ABBA Tribute Festival to save their dying town and rival their neighbor Parkes: home of the world's biggest Elvis Tribute Festival.
1601724.title: ABBA & Elvis in the Outback

1601839.synopsis: They follows two university professors over the course of a day. Lyudmil begins a new position at the university where Miho, the older chairman of the department, is busy juggling the social pressures of work and family. In the end, the two are seen living together as a couple, tender but cautious to keep their relationship secret.
1601839.title: They

1602089.synopsis: Japanese rock star HYDE’s concert performance from “HYDE [INSIDE] LIVE 2025 WORLD TOUR BEAUTY & THE BEAST” at KT Zepp Yokohama will be live streamed on Sunday, August 10, 2025. The concert will be available via worldwide live stream and also shown in theaters across Japan and Asia.
1602089.title: HYDE (INSIDE) LIVE 2025 WORLD TOUR: Beauty & The Beast

1602095.synopsis: Floeur Alder's parents are celebrated international ballet stars Lucette Aldous and Alan Alder and she grows up with god-mother Dame Margot Fonteyn and 'Uncle' Rudolf Nureyev. Like her parents, she trains in ballet. She is about to realise her goal to dance on the world stage when she is randomly stabbed in the neck by an unknown man on the streets of Perth. Facing years of physical rehabilitation, she turns to her family and dance to recover and, as the only child of celebrity parents, face the ultimate challenge to find her own way of dancing.
1602095.title: Pointe: Dancing on a Knife's Edge

1602101.synopsis: Reflections of Courage is a gripping documentary that follows Eddy Boas’s powerful account of his family’s survival during the Holocaust in Nazi-occupied Holland. As the youngest survivor, Eddy reveals how moments of bravery and kindness helped them endure unimaginable terror. This is a story of resilience, hope, and the courage to survive against all odds.
1602101.title: Reflections of Courage: The 'Eddy Boas Story'

1602111.synopsis: Nine post war migrants are interviewed in their houses and explain their survival in World War 2, migration to Australia. Travel on ships. Arrival in Australia. Life in migrant camps. Assimilation into Australian society.
1602111.title: Bonegilla: The Migrant's Journey

1602138.synopsis: Marking the 40th anniversary of winning a singing competition as part of a choir from his hometown of Modena in 1955, Luciano Pavarotti keeps a long-held promise and returns to the small town in North Wales to give a very special gala concert at the 1995 Llangollen International Musical Eisteddfod. Joining Pavarotti that evening is the BBC Philharmonic Orchestra, conducted by Leone Magiera, the modern day Corale Gioachino Rossini, Modena, directed by Paolo Rossini, and, for the finale, Japanese soprano Atzuko Kawahara. The program combines popular operatic arias and choruses, Neapolitan songs, one of Pavarotti’s own compositions, orchestral overtures and interludes, and a very special duet for the finale.
1602138.title: Pavarotti: The Lost Concert - Live at Llangollen 1995

1602259.synopsis: A whaling vessel drifts off-course as its captain hunts the mythical Kraken. Unbeknown to him, the Kraken is also on the hunt. After betrayal and destruction, the remaining crew must battle the beast in a final fight for survival.
1602259.title: Attack of the Kraken

1602459.synopsis: In a quiet village, Bhure's family faces poverty, fear, and old rivalries as Bhima and Pasho dream of a better future for their unborn child. With Dilawar, the rising influence of drugs, and fragile relationships, the lines between loyalty, greed, and truth blur, placing an innocent child in the eye of a storm.
1602459.title: Tera Bhanna Mitha Laage

1602483.synopsis: Andy's bogus job search comes to an end when they accept a mysterious position giving funerals to roadkill.
1602483.title: The Patron Saint of Roadkill

1602579.synopsis: For the first time in history a neurosurgeon describes communication with a live captured alien. This expanded version of Moment of Contact, New Revelations of Alien Encounters sees James Fox return to Brazil in the wake of congressional hearings in the United States. Ground-breaking interviews with former police chief, pathologists, and Dr Ítalo Venturelli who communicated with the alien.
1602579.title: Moment of Contact: New Revelations of Alien Encounters

1602673.synopsis: Following the death of Pope Francis, 135 cardinals enter the Vatican in total secrecy to pray, maneuver, and vote among themselves as both electors and candidates in an ancient ritual that determines the future of the Catholic Church.
1602673.title: Secrets of the Conclave

1602705.synopsis: A rebellious teen and a reserved caretaker form an unlikely bond in an orphanage as they come to terms with their painful pasts.
1602705.title: A Letter to My Youth

1602830.synopsis: A group of college students settle into what seems like an ordinary hostel, but things soon take a strange turn when a series of unexplained incidents begin to unfold. As their fun-filled hostel life descends into chaos, the students and their warden are forced to face the mysterious presence lurking within Maharaja Hostel.
1602830.title: Maharaja Hostel

1602838.synopsis: From San Diego Comic Con to on board Disney Cruise Line's Destiny, we're with the cast of the Emmy-winning Disney+ Original series "Percy Jackson and the Olympians" for a behind the scenes look at the popular fantasy series.
1602838.title: On The Red Carpet Presents: "Percy Jackson"

1603067.title: Gaming X Symphony – Legends and Quests in Concert

1603261.synopsis: A pharmaceutical trial promises Aya her lost memories, but as they return, her body begins to manifest them in disturbing ways.
1603261.title: A Thing of the Past

1603262.synopsis: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.
1603262.title: Everest: The Other Side

1603423.synopsis: In his 10th comedy special, Pandji Pragiwaksono riffs on Indonesian legal culture and the absurdities of daily life in this stand-up political satire.
1603423.title: Mens Rea

1603844.synopsis: Three friends bond and their coming of age graph against a backdrop of kite-flying as a sports event.
1603844.title: Patang

1603992.synopsis: In Willow Creek, sisters Whitney and Lynette face the challenges of Whitney's kidney failure together. As Whitney pursues her college dream, a kind teacher, Sebastian, is inspired by her strength. When he offers to donate his kidney, his selfless act sparks hope, love, and a life-saving donor chain that transforms their community.
1603992.title: A Heart Full of Hope

1604179.synopsis: A short absurd romantic comedy about Claude, a highly imaginative teenager who spends an evening going to increasingly elaborate and medieval lengths to try and concoct the perfect sexual fantasy.
1604179.title: The Knight

1604280.synopsis: The story of an Irish brewmaster who travels to America to reconnect with his daughter and transforms an old brewery into an authentic Irish pub. A story of redemption and faith through a heartfelt mix of romance, comedy, and drama.
1604280.title: God & Beer

1604290.synopsis: Year 1900, July 28: Gaetano Bresci, an Italian anarchist who had moved to America, arrives in Milan. The man has only one thought in his mind: to assassinate the King of Italy, Umberto I of Savoy.
1604290.title: Un delitto ideale

1604620.synopsis: With a fusion of intimate storytelling and broad reportage, No One Cares About Crazy People is an immersive deep dive into the crisis and chaos of severe mental illness (SMI). The documentary humanizes the face of SMI with a small cast of memorable characters, followed in real time over several years, as they — and also their families — navigate a system that too often seems to conspire against them. The historic roots of this national crisis are traced, as well as the emergence of bold but controversial activism that seeks to reinvent those failed policies. Inspired by the book of the same name by Pulitzer Prize-winning journalist and New York Times bestselling author Ron Powers. With narration by actor Bob Odenkirk and original music by Wilco frontman Jeff Tweedy.
1604620.title: No One Cares About Crazy People

1604647.synopsis: ive been thinking deeply about my work, trying to understand it a little more and i keep coming back to this idea or feeling that its all about transitions, changes... memories fade and life expands around this sense of sadness, or longing, or loss... sort of clinging to something we knew
1604647.title: Steamboat Willie (( Pt ii ))

1604660.synopsis: A man resorts to partying whilst stuck in an apartment.
1604660.title: As The Nights Go By

1604723.synopsis: James Blake joins three young men to explore why they're turned to the so-called manosphere to achieve success, and how it influences their real lives.
1604723.title: Men of the Manosphere

1605094.synopsis: What begins as a routine crime report soon spirals into a descent through eerie folklore, buried cults, and unsettling discoveries that blur the line between journalism and obsession.
1605094.title: Beliath

1605290.synopsis: Snoop Dogg and his merry friends sleigh through Minnesota on NFL Gameday to deliver a special holiday performance.
1605290.title: Snoop's Holiday Halftime Party

1605429.synopsis: Dead Bloom unfolds as a socially charged horror story about the lingering effects of environmental contamination and corporate denial.
1605429.title: Dead Bloom

1605903.synopsis: After returning home from a funeral, a couple discovers that Sharon's late mother's urn is at the center of a series of haunting disturbances, unraveling a chilling connection to a murder and a vengeful spirit.
1605903.title: Lady in the Urn

1606322.synopsis: The English Cemetery hides a dark secret. Behind the Tecolote mask lurks a bloodthirsty cannibal killer. Halloween in a Mexican town will be different—death's partner returns to spread terror.
1606322.title: El socio de la muerte

1606352.synopsis: A zombie outbreak confines people in an apartment building, forcing a mother to fight the undead to rescue her two children.
1606352.title: Urban Flesh Eaters

1607014.synopsis: In the year 2222 Earth's last living jungle is under attack from a power-hungry mogul. But Mowgli, a fearless eco-warrior raised by animals, isn't backing down. With his jungle crew he launches a dance-fueled rebellion to save nature.
1607014.title: Jungle Shake

1607127.synopsis: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.
1607127.title: One Last Shot

1608087.synopsis: From the streets of Brooklyn to the sun-soaked shores of Miami and the ballparks of San Francisco, Baseball Mensch traces the extraordinary life of Marty Lurie — a Miami Beach Senior High alum whose voice, wit, and wisdom have made him a beloved figure in the world of baseball.
1608087.title: Baseball Mensch:  The Marty Lurie Story

1608982.synopsis: Trapped in an underground pit during a storm, three students from an all-girls school must confront their personal conflicts as they fight to survive.
1608982.title: From the Ashes: The Pit

1609327.synopsis: Chronicles ten weeks with Lauda - a pioneering youth ensemble within the internationally renowned Shallaway Youth Choir, one of only a handful of choirs in the world to embrace all neurotypes. As the choristers prepare for their end of season concert, they reveal the joyful harmony they’ve found together while navigating a world not always tuned to their rhythm.
1609327.title: Sing the World Better

1609580.synopsis: A Japanese drama film that explores family issues in contemporary society.
1609580.title: STREET SMART

1609843.synopsis: A quantum physics student must fight for his life and the girl he loves when he discovers the universe is governed by 7 parallel timelines and her estranged ex-boyfriend is out to kill her in every single one.
1609843.title: The Time Vortex

1609943.synopsis: A teenager is caught between her attraction to a boy and the sinister presence that resides in her attic; a confused townie roams the countryside, convinced that the locals are out to get her; and in a world where everyone has a double, one woman seeks to be her own person. A twisted collection of tales that dig into the human psyche to expose the violent urges and hidden fears that lurk within.
1609943.title: From Her Bones

1610019.synopsis: Guided by a legendary figure of the Finnish wood throwing game, a group of mates form Australia’s first ever team to compete at the Mölkky World Championships.
1610019.title: First to Fifty

1610181.synopsis: Four women are pushed to their breaking point in Dhaka’s underbelly, where the only way to survive systemic exploitation is to stop being the prey and start being the threat.
1610181.title: Pressure Cooker

1610413.synopsis: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series.
1610413.title: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5

1610460.synopsis: Fleeing her past, a troubled hiker and her dog traverse the Appalachian Trail, only to fall under the spell of a dangerous man. As obsession and visions mount, she's drawn toward Mile 666, where lust, death, and something ancient await.
1610460.title: Mile 666

1610536.synopsis: Chase Atlantic's concert film captures their epic O2 Arena show closing the LOST IN HEAVEN Tour. The Australian trio, plus touring members, showcase years of growth that led to filling major venues and earning billions of streams.
1610536.title: Chase Atlantic: Lost in Heaven

1610646.synopsis: Madhan goes on a one-day date with Radhi, a beautiful girl who works at a spa; the day spirals into a dangerous chase as both the police and a gang hunt for Radhi, ending in a shocking truth that reveals their connection.
1610646.title: Dear Radhi

1610703.synopsis: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.
1610703.title: Infirmary

1610736.synopsis: A transgender woman returns home to finally come out to her parents, but as dinner spirals out of control, her anxieties manifest in sinister ways.
1610736.title: Homecoming

1610748.synopsis: Blind and low-vision kids take control of the cameras and capture their own experiences at the annual Braille Challenge — a weekend of high-pressure competition and raw coming-of-age moments.
1610748.title: Brailled It

1610774.synopsis: An experimental 16mm film that investigates colonial ideologies through aerodynamic, mechanical, and ballistic flight. Inside the Earth’s atmosphere, "First Breath on Mars" chronicles the establishment of ornithology in the United States. Outside the Earth’s atmosphere, the film probes into dreams of and developments in space exploration.
1610774.title: First Breath on Mars

1610829.synopsis: Josemon shirked responsibility while his sister Sarah gave up her dreams for the family. Artist Kaleena comes to paint the church and challenges him.
1610829.title: Velleppam

1610865.synopsis: Two brothers, Nick and Alex, embark on a worldwide journey to discover what life is like for other siblings living with Down's Syndrome. Along the way, they learn more about their own relationship and the special bond they share.
1610865.title: Downside Up

1610971.synopsis: One of the strange guests at the eerie inn is a serial killer, trapping a ventriloquist investigator and his wooden sidekick.
1610971.title: The Dummy Detective

1611230.synopsis: Two friends' attempt to rescue the home from financial ruin by renting out rooms which turns into a nightmare as the guests uncover the house's dark, ritual-filled past.
1611230.title: The Ritual House

1611487.synopsis: One minute. One mic. No mercy. Tony Hinchcliffe and a panel of famous guests put up-and-coming comedians to the test at a relentless Austin showcase.
1611487.title: Kill Tony: Once Upon a Time in Texas

1611586.synopsis: After nearly three years living in Japan, Fergus Gregg finds himself struggling to bid farewell to this beautiful country. On a journey tracing the path of his hero, the poet Matsuo Basho, Fergus decides to trek the northern landscapes of Tohoku. As he travels, he encounters more than he bargained for - facing setbacks, meetings with traditional hunter-gathers, and dances at northern Japan's largest Summer festival. Join Fergus Gregg on his 'Road to the North'.
1611586.title: Road to the North

1611629.synopsis: Hip-hop legend and hustler-turned-comedian Tip “T.I.” Harris is stepping into a whole new spotlight with his first-ever comedy special. From family drama to fame, and from the trap to the stage, nothing’s too wild (or too real) for T.I. to tackle. It’s raw. It’s unfiltered. And it’s funny as hell. Cheaper Than Therapy proves that sometimes the hardest-hitting lines aren’t in a verse—they’re in a joke.
1611629.title: Tip Harris: Cheaper Than Therapy

1611730.synopsis: A man on parole, a struggling mother, and a pair of drug dealing brothers each become part of a dizzying multiplicity of plots, but one story.  "The Devil Makes Work For Idle Hands" is a working class drama which focuses on social mobility, disillusionment, and the struggles of working class people. Seen through the perspectives of three characters, the film is loosely based on real life events and uses a mixture of professional and first time actors.
1611730.title: The Devil Makes Work For Idle Hands

1611790.synopsis: Nearly a year after catastrophic wildfires reshaped Los Angeles, Weathered host Maiya May returns to ask a question facing communities worldwide: what does recovery truly look like in an era of escalating climate extremes? What she finds goes far beyond one city - survivors still grappling with loss, systemic failures, and unanswered questions that echo across fire-prone regions on every continent.  As climate-driven wildfires intensify from California to Australia, Southern Europe, and beyond, Maiya’s investigation uncovers an emerging blueprint for wildfire-resilient communities - highlighting innovation, adaptation, and collective action that transcend borders. Both urgent and hopeful, the film offers a timely, internationally relevant roadmap for how societies can prepare for a hotter, more volatile future.
1611790.title: Weathered: After the LA Firestorm

1611875.synopsis: A film collaboration between Quenten Agius (Aboriginal storyteller) and Kim Mavromatis (mixed media producer). Filmed on Ngadjuri country, Mid North and Southern Flinders Ranges region of South Australia. The film incorporates 10 years of archival material, shot with 8 different cameras, including 3 drones and a mobile phone camera.
1611875.title: Ngadjuri - Spirit And Songs Of Country

1611977.synopsis: After his wife's consciousness is transferred into their android maid, a widower finds himself trapped in a deadly love triangle when the jealous A.I. goes to terrifying lengths to prevent him from moving on with a new woman.
1611977.title: Housemaid

1612018.synopsis: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.
1612018.title: Jackass: Best and Last

1612139.synopsis: A man desperate to disappear must embrace the very past he's running from when a relentless genetically enhanced killer hunts him down.
1612139.title: Eidolon

1612251.synopsis: When a struggling high school student is confronted with the painful fracture of her family, she seeks refuge far from the noise of her parents’ world. In the company of her grandmother and an old friend, she begins to see life from a distance---both tender and selfless. Her lessons and realizations are things that cannot be learned from books, but only from a life lived.
1612251.title: Until She Remembers

1612291.synopsis: The world of the supernatural meets the wild west when a small group of solders enter Apache county to find their missing comrade. Quickly, they discover something is terribly wrong as the very land itself appears to have turned against them. As they face demons of both man and myth, it's going to take all they have to survive.
1612291.title: Blood Totem

1612522.synopsis: Jack, a quadriplegic, and Lina, his day nurse, spy on neighbors with a drone and stumble upon a serial killer. When Lina finds a mysterious relic inside the killer's house, it transports her and Jack to an underworld where they switch bodies and are forced to kill for a creature. Embracing the killing inside Lina's body, will Jack want to switch back?
1612522.title: Give Me Back My Body!

1613035.synopsis: It follows an ordinary family whose lives are abruptly transformed by extraordinary luck—unraveling how money can both bind people together and quietly pull them apart.
1613035.title: The Lotto Winner

1613335.synopsis: This is the story of the “Miracle on Ice,” when the 1980 US Hockey Team beat the USSR in the Olympic semi-finals at the height of the Cold War to bring home a gold medal. Their iconic underdog story is told with never-before-seen 16mm footage and firsthand reflections from the players who were brought back to the scene of their historic victory.
1613335.title: Miracle: The Boys of '80

1613798.synopsis: The brutal murder of the wife of “Toro,” a military hero in the special forces, turns him into a man with a single purpose: revenge. After a stroke of fate makes him a millionaire, Carlos transforms his fortune into an arsenal and, together with his closest soldiers, sets out to hunt down those responsible.
1613798.title: Vengeance

1614424.synopsis: PLEASE NOTE: June 2027 is not a confirmed date. It is our target completion date and may change.  Born In Blue is produced using Unreal Engine. Unreal Engine is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. All rights reserved.  Set in Mount Gambier, South Australia, the film follows Lumy, a young girl who witnesses her father’s sacrifice at the edge of the mysterious Blue Lake. Growing up with unhealed trauma and an unexplainable power tied to the water itself, Lumy retreats into science while being quietly hunted by forces she doesn’t fully understand.  Years later, she forms a deep connection with a broken but kindred soul, Ashton. Together, they become scientists and uncover a dangerous truth buried beneath the lake one that links Lumy’s existence to a phenomenon capable of reshaping reality. As the past resurfaces and the hunters return, Lumy must confront what her father died to protect. Born In Blue is a story of grief, survival, inheritance, and the cost of love.
1614424.title: born blue

1614492.synopsis: A graveyard rendezvous that isn’t just about love, but about fulfilling a promise – and facing its consequences.  A family weekend that digs up buried secrets – secrets that perhaps should have stayed underground forever.  A legendary VHS tape, worth killing for – or maybe someone already has.  And a childhood tale that proves, years later: sometimes the scariest things are the ones we believed were true as kids.  From Horrorszkóp and Cruel World Team comes four dark and unsettling stories in this chilling horror anthology.  Each one steeped in the shadow of death, human weakness, and the grim truth that the ending is never what you expect.  Four stories. Four secrets. Four inevitable ends.
1614492.title: The Four Gates of Death

1614709.synopsis: During the 1980s, the American journalist Edward Serotta documented the harsh realities and Jewish life in socialist Romania. The secret services clandestinely accompanied him on his journey. A photo essay from opposing perspectives.
1614709.title: Shot Reverse Shot

1615229.synopsis: Born In Blue is produced using Unreal Engine and set in Mount Gambier (Berrin), South Australia. The story follows Lumy, a young girl who grows up in New Zealand before moving with her father to the quiet volcanic town beside the Blue Lake. In the late 1800s, time traveling villains arrive from the future, drawn to a powerful phenomenon beneath the lake and seeking Lumy herself. At the lake’s edge, her father sacrifices his life to protect her, altering the course of time. Marked by trauma and a mysterious bond to the water, Lumy grows up driven by grief and unanswered questions, turning to science while unaware she is still being hunted. Years later, alongside fellow scientist Ashton, she uncovers the truth the same force beneath Berrin fuels both the villains’ technology and her own ability to move through time. Realising what she has inherited, Lumy prepares to fight back and protect what her father died to save.
1615229.title: Born In Blue

1615734.synopsis: A brave group of international volunteers take their converted truck into Ukraine’s Eastern frontline villages to cook, hand out free pizzas and paint the faces of the children. Their presence offers a brief moment of joy and escapism in ‘forgotten’ villages, many of which had been occupied by Russia and which now face reoccupation; villages that have been largely abandoned by their government and by other aid agencies.
1615734.title: Pizza Under Fire

1615742.synopsis: Sir Frank Lowy has lived many lives. Born in Slovakia in 1930, he lost his father in the Holocaust, he fought in the Arab-Israeli War in 1948 and left Israel in 1952 for Australia to join family members who had settled in Sydney. There, Lowy met fellow immigrant John Saunders and together they opened their first shopping centre in Sydney in 1959, which led to the multi-billion-dollar international shopping centre empire, Westfield Corporation.
1615742.title: To Be a Jew: Frank Lowy In His Own Words

1616131.synopsis: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
1616131.title: A Child of My Own

1616263.synopsis: Kishii Samanosuke reunites with Heizo, battling deadly foes to protect a hunted girl and face master thief Koazu no Gentan.
1616263.title: Samurai Detective Onihei: Two Righteous Swords

1616400.synopsis: Tells the story of 28-year-old Horizon Air ground service agent Richard “Beebo” Russell, who, to the shock of all who knew him, clocked into work wearing a shirt that said “sky’s no limit,” stole a 33-million-dollar plane, and took off into the skies of the Pacific Northwest embarking on a white-knuckle flight that would come to embody the hopes, dreams, and despair of the American working class, and offer a timely look into the U.S. mental health crisis.
1616400.title: #SKYKING

1616674.synopsis: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.
1616674.title: Me Before Me

1616700.synopsis: Mo Gilligan takes on Hollywood — and lives to tell the tale. In this lively special, the Londoner dishes on fame, family and being British in America.
1616700.title: Mo Gilligan: In the Moment

1617115.synopsis: With a dark past in the foster system, a lonely woman questions if her new found half-brother is also the violent stalker wracking havoc on her.
1617115.title: Brother Unknown

1617810.synopsis: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.
1617810.title: Ice Twister

1617908.synopsis: Taylor Tomlinson takes her fans to church with hilarious confessions about dating in her 30s, her dream assistant and why she refuses to use AI.
1617908.title: Taylor Tomlinson: Prodigal Daughter

1618086.synopsis: A group of teens dare each other to summon a mysterious figure from an old urban legend but what was suppose to be a harmless game turns deadly when one of them breaks an unspoken rule, unleashing the terrifying entity into the real world. Now hunted one by one, the friends must uncover the dark origins of the legend and find a way to banish the spirit before the knocking comes for them next.—Joseph Mazzaferro
1618086.title: The Knock Knock Man

1618196.synopsis: Following a catastrophic train derailment, The Bulldogs follows the residents of a small rural community in East Palestine, Ohio, as they navigate an uncertain path to recovery.
1618196.title: The Bulldogs

1618837.synopsis: The “gay male nuns” of Sydney’s Order of Perpetual Indulgence have been shocking, delighting and confounding audiences with their satirical activism for over four decades, but does this bold brand of activism still hold relevance today?
1618837.title: Old Habits

1618838.synopsis: An intimate, autobiographical story of a transformative pair of pants and a childhood refusal to conform to societal expectations of gender.
1618838.title: Tarzan Pants

1618843.synopsis: Three college seniors venture to the abandoned Dizzy Dishes cabaret club while researching its fiery past. They encounter the former owner, Betty — who claims to be half woman, half “something else.”
1618843.title: Betty's Revenge

1618945.synopsis: Thando is perpetually unlucky in love, but when her bestie returns from his travels with a fiancée in tow, she's forced to face a new emotion — jealousy.
1618945.title: Yoh! Bestie

1619250.synopsis: Imagine a time when Earth was a molten, volcanic wasteland, constantly bombarded by colossal asteroids. We’ve long feared these cosmic impacts as destroyers of life – just ask the dinosaurs – but what if they were the key to our very existence? Explore a revolutionary new theory suggesting that these violent collisions provided the essential ingredients – water, minerals, and energy – needed for life to ignite on our planet. Discover how scientists are unearthing evidence from lunar rocks and ancient impact craters, revealing that the very objects once thought to extinguish life might have actually sparked it.
1619250.title: Asteroids: The Spark of Life?

1619417.synopsis: A group of vloggers investigate an abandoned research facility, where long-buried secrets transform their search into a desperate fight for survival.
1619417.title: The Bigfoot Experiment

1619533.synopsis: In the Arctic Circle, Jason Fox and an elite team of military veterans open up to each other about men’s mental health while taking on one of the world’s toughest ultramarathons.
1619533.title: Arctic Adventure: Ultimate Survival

1619989.synopsis: Shadowlands is an anthology series that explores love in three distinct stories: a couple renegotiating a relationship, a narcissist seeking to understand it, and star-crossed lovers mourning its loss.
1619989.title: Shadowlands

1620025.synopsis: Nothing is what it seems-five gripping tales where every secret hides something darker.
1620025.title: Beneath The Surface

1620034.synopsis: Martin Short looks back on a life fueled by joy in this documentary with classic clips, fresh interviews and star-studded, never-before-seen home movies.
1620034.title: Marty, Life Is Short

1620080.synopsis: As the leader of Polish rock band Lady Pank, Jan Borysewicz shapes a generation with his music, while a string of family tragedies shapes him.
1620080.title: Less of a Stranger

1620119.synopsis: A psychiatrist struggles to aid her stranded family and patients while grappling with her own mental state.
1620119.title: Dr. Quarantine

1620551.synopsis: A teenager, the only hearing member of a deaf family, finds her voice and learns to believe in herself through her passion for singing.
1620551.title: Feel My Voice

1620682.synopsis: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?
1620682.title: Love in Slow Motion

1620711.synopsis: Jean and Brendan have been dating for a couple months now. It's that sweet spot: Brendan's still enamored with Jean's career as a painter and Jean still finds Brendan's less-than-clever jokes funny. But as they begin to enter the thrilling and butterfly-inducing journey of physical intimacy, it is revealed that all may not be well. Brendan's riddled with anxieties in the bedroom, and Jean's own residence is overshadowed by something potentially more lethal: A poltergeist.
1620711.title: Its Presence Between Us

1620829.synopsis: Three generations living under one leaky Wellington roof in 2003, all on the brink of transformation. Sixteen-year-old Cassie is all bravado and vulnerability, drifting into risky territory as she searches for validation in all the wrong places. Her mother Maxine, 52, a formidable single-mother filmmaker on the brink of a long-awaited breakthrough, is finally offered a greenlight - if she can just land a star. Holding everything together is Huia, Cassie’s grandmother, 80, whose life has been defined by quiet service to family and a private obsession with raising monarch caterpillars, dreaming of one day witnessing the legendary butterfly migration in Mexico. But when Huia’s mind begins to fail her, the family is thrust into chaos. Can the maternal line hold together while everything is throwing them apart?
1620829.title: Caterpillar

1620845.synopsis: When a local Ten Pin Bowling Alley in the northern suburbs of Melbourne Australia puts on a Pro Amateur competition with the biggest cash prize in the country, the local league players try their luck.
1620845.title: Spare Time

1620918.synopsis: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.
1620918.title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald

1620943.synopsis: Jija Jung Bahadur, a man who knows everything about nothing, lands at his in-laws' home and turns life upside down. His ego and antics spark endless clashes with brothers-in-law Pinky and Gogi as they prepare to marry off their sister.
1620943.title: Welcome Jija Ji

1620991.synopsis: An engaging and thought-provoking look at Lucy Letby, the former nurse serving life in prison after being convicted of the murders of seven infants and the attempted murders of seven others.
1620991.title: The Investigation of Lucy Letby

1621024.synopsis: The epic duel between Djokovic and Nadal, showcasing their physical brilliance, mental resilience and emotional intensity. Explore how this match raised the bar for physical and mental demands in tennis, and inspired upcoming players.
1621024.title: The Match That Changed Tennis

1621113.synopsis: BRIT-winning and Grammy-nominated band Bring Me The Horizon's biggest headline show to date. Shot at São Paulo’s Allianz Parque Stadium, performed in front of a sold-out crowd of 50,000, the film expands the visual universe of POST HUMAN by blending cinematic visuals, fan-submitted videos and showcasing characters such as E.V.E, Selene & M8. It delivers an immersive experience that rivals that electric night in Brazil. The performance spans the full evolution of BMTH’s discography, from Sempiternal and That’s the Spirit to amo and the POST HUMAN albums. L.I.V.E. in São Paulo brings the viewer in, and never lets them go.
1621113.title: Bring Me the Horizon: L.I.V.E. in São Paulo

1621114.synopsis: Sydney's rare condition makes her collapse whenever emotions run high-especially in love. When her charming new neighbor Taylor steals her heart, she must fight to stay awake long enough to turn her dream romance into reality.
1621114.title: Sleeping Beauty Next Door

1621552.synopsis: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.
1621552.title: Facing El Chapo

1621612.synopsis: In 1992, semi-retired detective and author Martin Dye is hired to track down a missing duffel bag of cash tied to a fatal 1970s crash that left one friend dead and another in a wheelchair. As Martin follows the trail through old classmates, small-town gossip, and buried lies, he uncovers a dark legacy of drugs, betrayal, and shattered lives - and learns some secrets refuse to stay buried.
1621612.title: Tears to a Glass Eye

1621636.synopsis: Furr Fever is the wild, fuzzed-up guitar-slinger of The Sextortions, a rockabilly band as deranged as they are irresistible. When Furr crosses paths with the howling, leather-clad Wolfy Howl, the two lost souls collide in a blaze of glitter and guitars in overdrive. But scheming music moguls, a corrupt Trump-ish mayor and a backstabbing bandmate are all gunning to tame them. Fortunately, the ghost of The King lives in Furr’s gold guitar, and rock and roll cannot be caged.
1621636.title: Wolf Cat Fever

1621842.synopsis: A gangster-in-training kidnaps the daughter of a prominent businessman in an attempt to win his boss' favour, but gets caught up in a web of deceit and conflict.
1621842.title: Bebe Main Badmash Banuga

1621987.synopsis: Beneath a cloud dog, a young woman swims. Later, she meets her brother at a cafe. A man from another place arrives and invites her to a private concert.
1621987.title: Jazzer Mouse

1622032.synopsis: Get ready for comedic royalty as the Undisputed Queen of Comedy, Sommore, returns to Detroit for her 7th special, performing up close and personal at the Garden Theatre, recorded on June 28th.
1622032.title: Sommore: Chandelier Fly

1622039.synopsis: We get a glimpse into the fractured mind of an anxious news anchor one minute before going live.
1622039.title: The Anchor

1622226.synopsis: When a brother and sister are reunited after years of separation, they uncover a dark secret about one of the worlds largest pharmaceutical companies. Eager to expose the truth, they have no choice but to face their darkest fears together.

1622490.synopsis: On Halloween night, a carefree nurse is overtaken by the vengeful spirit of a notorious serial killer—one who believes their victims had it coming.
1622490.title: Blue Murder

1623007.synopsis: An American marketing executive travels to Tuscany to revamp a pasta sauce brand. There, she clashes and subsequently falls for a handsome, stubborn local chef.
1623007.title: Chef’s Kiss

1623070.synopsis: Comedian Udom Taephanich shares candid stories from his chaotic life, from superstition and dark rituals to his time in Korea.
1623070.title: Deaw Still Alive

1623111.synopsis: Amanda Knox returns to Italy to confront Giuliano Mignini, the prosecutor who locked her up for a murder she did not commit
1623111.title: Mouth of the Wolf: Amanda Knox Returns to Italy

1623125.synopsis: Veteran naturalist Sir David Attenborough tells the story of a remarkable group of gorillas, from his first encounter in the '70s to the present day.
1623125.title: A Gorilla Story: Told by David Attenborough

1623256.synopsis: When a storm traps old university pals at a luxury lodge, their civilized birthday bash spirals into a cyclone of betrayals, grudges and unfiltered chaos.
1623256.title: The Storm

1623260.synopsis: Three young sisters share a rented apartment in Rome’s university district with their respective boyfriends. Active in the student collective yet openly opposed to its leadership, they see themselves as guardians of a legacy of betrayed struggles, convinced they can renew a true sense of the “commons” on a small scale. Marginalized and outnumbered within the collective, they decide to make a documentary about the student occupation of the university.
1623260.title: Three sisters

1623526.synopsis: The Opening Ceremony of Milano Cortina 2026 features blockbuster acts from international artists including five-time Grammy Award-winner Mariah Carey, Golden Globe winner Laura Pausini and famed Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli, to the award-winning actor and producer Pierfrancesco Favino and The White Lotus’ Emmy-nominated star Sabrina Impacciatore.
1623526.title: Milano Cortina 2026 Olympic Opening Ceremony: Harmony

1623583.synopsis: A documentary style examination of the artistic process, delving into the creation of a project that takes an immeasurable toll on its creator.
1623583.title: I BURNT MY BRAIN FOR YOU

1623867.synopsis: An elite real estate agent who lost the ability to lie due to a curse must navigate the cutthroat industry using only the honest truth.
1623867.title: The Honest Realtor

1623927.synopsis: Granny is an upcoming film directed by Vijaya Kumara, starring Vadivukkarasi, Dhileepan, Singampuli, Gaja Raja, Ananthu Nag, and Aparna in prominent roles.
1623927.title: Granny

1624039.synopsis: A history of encounters in Edmonton and British Columbia.
1624039.title: Tracking the Wendigo

1624363.synopsis: A Tongan/Kiwi warrior who could run 100 metres in under 11 seconds. He was the youngest All Black to put on the jersey and still holds the record for the most tries scored in World Cup history.
1624363.title: Lomu

1624564.synopsis: During a film shoot at a crew member's ancestral home in Perak, a production team's set is plagued by escalating trouble and eerie disruptions that threaten the entire project.
1624564.title: Libang Libu

1624613.synopsis: Lainey Wilson redefines what it means to be a modern country star while exploring her struggles and triumphs at a pivotal career moment.
1624613.title: Lainey Wilson: Keepin' Country Cool

1624621.synopsis: A tender romantic drama about two young hearts brought together by fate. Kumari explores love, emotions, and the courage to choose the heart despite life’s challenges. A soulful Valentine-season love story.
1624621.title: Kumari

1624803.synopsis: New Year’s Eve. Sarah is working - again. Nick is her only customer - again. Same old same old. Except this year, their countdown to midnight will be the strangest and deadliest they have ever known. Why is an executioner Dalek targeting these two people, in this place, on this night? Why are they having to live through the same moments again? Can the Doctor, Yaz and Dan save them and survive into the New Year?
1624803.title: Doctor Who: Eve of the Daleks

1624931.synopsis: Three friends embark on a new experience only to find that they weren’t quite ready for what was in store for them.
1624931.title: Threefold

1624950.synopsis: Loud music, charismatic vocalists, broken guitars and drunk fans. The fervent and accepting Melbourne music scene in shown through local rock band Mindstain. Meet the magnetic members of the band. Encounter the sociable fans that thrive in the community. Feel the vigorous intensity that is the chaotic mosh pic. Hear the booming impassioned music and discover what makes this community so special.
1624950.title: Golden Age

1625328.synopsis: In the summer of 2022, a miner struck more than gold outside Dawson City, in Canada’s Yukon. A fully preserved infant woolly mammoth that died 36,000 years ago protruded from the Arctic permafrost, her flesh still pink and green grass in her belly. The creature’s discovery reignited interest in a species that has long inspired scientific curiosity.
1625328.title: Mammoth Hunters

1625381.synopsis: The sequel to the 2025 film. Plot TBA.
1625381.title: Heart Eyes 2

1625875.synopsis: In this meta found-footage / documentary escapade, Gavin and Alex head to Tennessee to document the premiere of their previous film, and to follow a tip that will lead them to the most liminal spaces in Chattanooga...
1625875.title: The Chattanooga Syndrome - NOCLIP 3

1626170.synopsis: In an isolated village, young Prathap seeks opportunity but enters a world of deception. Drawn into uncontrollable forces, he's caught between progress and preservation, testing his beliefs and purpose.
1626170.title: Sing Geetham

1626188.synopsis: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.
1626188.title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter

1626279.synopsis: After losing her boyfriend in a car accident. Shelly hesitant about dating again, until she's introduced to the charming Les Harris, who has alternative motives.
1626279.title: Unauthorized Love

1626675.synopsis: To join the elite ATIC Guard, Alana Toro must pass one final test: enter a simulation, prevent a terrorist attack, and prove her loyalty. Every mistake resets the clock. Every death disappears - except in her memory, where the weight keeps building. The more Alana learns, the more she begins to question the organisation she fought so hard to join.
1626675.title: Voidance

1626841.synopsis: After a jail stint, Slim hears about hidden legendary cough syrup and plots to steal it with his partner Pack, leading to betrayals and danger as they chase the score through the criminal underworld.
1626841.title: Double Cup

1627046.synopsis: How did PFAS chemicals once used in popular stain-resistant carpets end up in the water and environment in parts of Georgia, Alabama and South Carolina? FRONTLINE, The Associated Press, The Atlanta Journal-Constitution, The Post and Courier and AL.com investigate what happened with these forever chemicals and the ongoing health impacts. The joint investigation draws on thousands of pages of documents and court depositions and interviews with former regulators and industry insiders, as well as doctors, scientists and people who have the kinds of illnesses that researchers have linked to PFAS contamination.
1627046.title: Contaminated: The Carpet Industry's Toxic Legacy

1627382.synopsis: A married woman's secret affair spirals out of control when her brother in law traps everyone inside the house to expose the truth. As tensions rise, a violent accident forces everyone to question loyalty, love, and who the real victim is.
1627382.title: His Brother's Wife

1627696.synopsis: Officer Wray is determined to prove to his boss that he has what it takes to bring justice for an innocent victim involved in a murder case gone wrong. His boss assigns him onto a recent murder case involving 7 suspects who all had the potential to have committed this murder. As Officer Wray digs deeper into this mystery, with the help of a key witness and a helpful journalist, the situation becomes more and more dangerous for not just himself, but for everyone involved...
1627696.title: "It's Murder!"

1627824.synopsis: When one of Humdinger's schemes goes awry, a Junkyard Kitten's home is destroyed and Rocky bites off more than he can chew when he invites the kitten to stay at the Lookout overnight. While the kitten causes more trouble than expected, Rocky learns that even heroes need help.
1627824.title: Rocky's Cat-astrophe

1627976.synopsis: Hashtag Star follows the story of a social media influencer. Just when everything seems perfect, a forgotten mistake from her past resurfaces. As secrets discloses in the public eye, a celebrated social media influencer is forced to confront the truth, testing her reputation, relationships, and the cost of online fame.
1627976.title: Hashtag Star

1628116.synopsis: They're back! BTS gathers in LA to record their album "Arirang" in this documentary offering unprecedented access to the band as they enter a new era.
1628116.title: BTS: THE RETURN

1628123.synopsis: BTS is back. The iconic group returns to the stage for a live reunion concert to perform legendary hits and unveil brand-new tracks.
1628123.title: BTS THE COMEBACK LIVE | ARIRANG

1628345.synopsis: The House of Beckham is at war. But what's the truth behind the accusations?
1628345.title: The Beckham Feud: Truth & Lies

1628367.synopsis: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.
1628367.title: Kartavya

1628442.synopsis: an Australian independent drama directed by Duncan James, following a bored, suburban housewife named Suze who discovers shocking secrets about her husband during a solo road trip. The 1h 23m film explores themes of guilt, redemption, and complex family dynamics with a French-cinema-inspired style.
1628442.title: Misgivings

1628448.synopsis: In this dark comedy, a woman calls her estranged daughters in the middle of the night with chilling news — there's a dead body in her kitchen.
1628448.title: Maa Behen

1628484.synopsis: Back for his fourth Netflix stand-up special, comedy icon Katt Williams delivers his famously bold takes on conspiracies, celebrities and the world at large in this electrifying set.
1628484.title: Katt Williams: The Last Report

1628545.synopsis: The last living descendants of a once-thriving Black neighborhood in Athens, GA, come together to fight to preserve the memory of Linnentown. Their family homes were razed in a 1960s urban renewal project, and now they, along with civic-minded neighbors, unite to try to reclaim their forgotten history and seek redress.
1628545.title: Linnentown

1629172.synopsis: A short documentary about a man, his legacy and his impact on the world.
1629172.title: T.G.

1629326.synopsis: Minh Như returns to her family’s dye workshop after years of exile. There, she confronts terrifying supernatural phenomena and uncovers the brutal truth behind her mother’s death and a blood-soaked pact from the past.
1629326.title: The Corpse 2

1629356.synopsis: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.
1629356.title: Capturing Bigfoot

1629367.synopsis: When the World Cup landed in the U.S. in 1994, it arrived in a country with no league, no culture, and no clue. A ragtag group of players faced an impossible task: don't embarrass their nation in front of the entire world.
1629367.title: Summer of '94

1629369.synopsis: An intimate, arresting portrait of cyclist Moriah Wilson—raised by a fierce, loving family—whose singular drive becomes her superpower, carrying her to athletic brilliance and, devastatingly, toward a life cut short by murder.
1629369.title: The Truth and Tragedy of Moriah Wilson

1629373.synopsis: A quiet revolution is underway: As the real-world consequences of social media come into focus, a new generation of parents and teens step forward to challenge the systems shaping their lives and fight for a different future.
1629373.title: Your Attention Please

1629382.synopsis: Grieving and facing the consequences of their crimes, the Traoré brothers get one last chance to forge a new path.
1629382.title: Street Flow 3

1629517.synopsis: Three of the youngest Turpin siblings tell their stories of the past and how they experienced abuse a second time in the foster care system.
1629517.title: The Turpins: A New House of Horror - A Diane Sawyer Special Event

1629790.synopsis: "For months we experimented and represented ourselves, starting with simple walks in search of material for a thesis. How can we visually recreate a memory? We walked and filmed, photographed and painted, got to know each other and told our stories. An experience transformed into a story that speaks of a shared journey, made up of filming, changes of season, conversations about the moon, and exchanges of techniques. Inspired by “Dark Side of the Moon,” we tried to represent the intimate and personal emotions that came to us through the album. Each song has a language, each movement a color, each sound an expression. What remains today, half a century later? Something inexplicable, perhaps. A wonderful creation of friendship and mutual artistic esteem, the (re)creation of multiple memories, which overlap like membranes on the screen. - Erik Negro
1629790.title: Return to the Moon (or Nothing)

1629962.synopsis: The Story of Sam Regulus and his adventures to find his missing brother Jason
1629962.title: Echoes of Dread

1630021.synopsis: What’s next for Venezuela after the dramatic fall of Nicolás Maduro? In a documentary from the filmmakers behind A Dangerous Assignment, FRONTLINE and The Associated Press investigate the legacy of corruption in Venezuela, the challenges to democracy, the conflict with the U.S., and the fight over who will control the oil-rich country.
1630021.title: Crisis In Venezuela

1630030.synopsis: The fantastical and magnificent city of Chang'an, a city woven with gears and mechanisms, is home to both humans and demons living side by side beneath its upturned eaves. Di Shao, a genius young man aspiring to become "Chang'an's Number One Detective," possesses exceptional crime-solving skills and a sharp tongue; while Asa, a rookie wolf demon constable, is formidable in martial arts yet kind-hearted. A bizarre murder case forces these two adversaries to team up, embarking on a hilarious and bickering detective journey. As clues point to the heart of the city, can this unreliable duo protect the joyful daily life of this fantastical city? And what earth-shattering secret lies hidden behind the bustling and prosperous Chang'an?
1630030.title: Demon Agent

1630293.synopsis: Two sisters returning to their family home after their mother's death, only to confront the monsters they accidentally conjured with a Ouija board.
1630293.title: They Wait in Shadows

1630409.synopsis: Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.
1630409.title: The Debt Collector

1630423.synopsis: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.
1630423.title: My Dearest Assassin

1630433.synopsis: Three women fall prey to a ruthless phone scam. To settle the score, they'll take on the criminal network that stole their money — and their dignity.
1630433.title: The Red Line

1630440.synopsis: Two escaped convicts break into a house and take a hostage, only to discover that the hideout houses something far more dangerous: a voodoo curse born from a grieving couple’s thirst for vengeance. As the night spirals into terror, they must battle an unseen power that feeds on guilt, blood, and lost souls.
1630440.title: Bad Voodoo

1630661.synopsis: Follows Indians facing challenges while trying to travel to the USA and the struggles they encounter after reaching there.
1630661.title: Gaayapadda Simham

1630747.synopsis: Marshall Brooker is a relic hunter for hire. On his latest job, he discovers an ancient mask that seems to possess supernatural powers. Instead of turning it over to his employers, he attempts to hold it hostage until the price is raised. Unfortunately for him, the man paying for his treks into the jungle is Roman Stalnik, a heartless collector of relics, and a man who already knows their power. Now, Brooker must find a way to protect his family and get out alive, before the occult cabal funding Roman gets their hands on the relic.
1630747.title: Brooker

1631239.synopsis: As wild bears adapt to suburban life, they show us we're not so different. Co-thriving begins with us.
1631239.title: Bears in Hot Tubs

1631285.synopsis: The film examines girlhood as inherited performance-costumes worn before identity forms. Mona frames femininity as simultaneous nurture and constraint, exploring how intimacy between girls and garments becomes predetermined theatre. Clothing functions as ritual and control, dictating movement before self-knowledge arrives.
1631285.title: Discipline

1631485.synopsis: A former communist militant and a "live and let live" man form an unlikely friendship on a park bench, sharing their life stories with humor and heart.
1631485.title: Strangers in the Park

1631682.synopsis: Diagnosed at birth with a rare condition that was expected to kill him, Chad "Shorty" McDaniel embraces humor, grit, and a competitive spirit to live the life others said he would never have and shatter assumptions about disability.
1631682.title: 96 Pounds of Dynamite

1631800.synopsis: A documentary about the life and career of the first Black animator at Disney, Ron Husband.
1631800.title: Huz: Drawn to Life

1631807.synopsis: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.
1631807.title: The Secret Woman

1631856.synopsis: When a series of unfortunate coincidences involving a woman, her husband and her ex, culminates in a shocking death, her long-lost sister returns to redeem her.
1631856.title: Oh Butterfly!

1631917.synopsis: A spirited teen dreaming of the perfect debut makes a deal with a lonely newcomer, but unexpected feelings and revelations may shatter their plans.
1631917.title: 18th Rose

1632473.synopsis: A TV writer returns home to her estranged mother, igniting chaos as they navigate painful secrets and the  complexities of their dysfunctional family.
1632473.title: This, That, and Everything in Between

1632563.synopsis: After a tragic choice leads him to the brink, a disillusioned artist named Michael awakens on a mysterious beach. a liminal space where lost souls come to confront their pasts. Guided by Bob, a charismatic yet enigmatic caretaker, Michael embarks on a surreal journey through the pivotal moments of his life: love, heartbreak, and devastating loss. As he confronts hidden truths and unspoken regrets, Michael is faced with one profound question: Was it worth it, and what would life be like if he had stayed?
1632563.title: If You had Stayed

1632759.synopsis: Creature of the Pines is a found footage horror movie set in the legendary New Jersey Pine Barrens, one of the most mysterious and unsettling stretches of wilderness in America. Locals have whispered about strange sightings and disappearances for generations, but few people are willing to talk about what they’ve seen, and even fewer dare to go looking.
1632759.title: Creature of the Pines

1632818.synopsis: A group of adult models turned thieves who face unintended consequences after stealing a camcorder that houses the spirit of a murdered child.
1632818.title: Dark Distortion

1632879.synopsis: From the Cadillac Palace Theatre in Chicago, comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first HBO stand-up special. A high-energy performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another – from Trader Joe’s to Oreos, NPR, and dog breeds – Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines, and more.
1632879.title: Chris Fleming: Live at The Palace

1633056.synopsis: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.
1633056.title: All Wishes Come True!

1633264.synopsis: With rare access and no holds barred, the acclaimed documentarian investigates a growing ultra-masculine network and its controversial influencers.
1633264.title: Louis Theroux: Inside the Manosphere

1633390.synopsis: After an amateur comedian is thrown in jail for political satire, The Onion joins his fight for free speech in a case that helps draw national attention to police conduct and accountability.
1633390.title: Crime & Parody

1633410.synopsis: Bruce Bruce returns after 14 years with his Netflix debut "I Ain't Playin'" - observing generational chaos and life's craziness through personal stories.
1633410.title: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'

1633759.synopsis: Two teenagers, Tom and Mac, are pulled and chased around Brisbane city as they argue about drugs, kickons and their life ambitions.
1633759.title: Sips

1633832.synopsis: Across six chilling stories, strangers face the terrifying consequences of their choices as a creeping nightmare begins to invade their lives.
1633832.title: Insidious Tales

1634198.synopsis: Growing Up Nyima is a documentary film that follows Nyima Tucker, a young woman of Ngarluma, Banjima, and Yamatji heritage, as she moves between the worlds of city and country. Born in the Pilbara and raised in Karratha before relocating to Perth at sixteen, Nyima’s journey captures the tension between modern life and ancestral connection. Across the 1,500 km that separate these landscapes, she grapples with questions of identity, belonging, and the meaning of home.
1634198.title: Growing Up Nyima: Between Two Worlds

1634301.synopsis: A descendant of the Vanara clan is pushed into conflict when a modern-day Ravana seizes his only bike for an election rally. What starts as a petty injustice soon erupts into a fierce fight for self-respect and dignity.
1634301.title: Vanaveera

1634383.director: Thomas van Gool, Prospera Holder Young
1634383.synopsis: Victoria flies through the world solo, spending her days riding an e-scooter through the city, dealing second-rate vapes to teenagers she has no patience for. But, when her routine is disrupted by an encounter with a mysterious stranger who makes her feel seen, she questions if there might be another way she could be doing things.
1634383.title: Who is Still Dreaming?

1634392.director: Thomas van Gool, Prospera Holder Young
1634392.synopsis: A couple arguing about curtains decide to stop arguing and start dancing instead.
1634392.title: Dance to Soothe Nothing

1634479.synopsis: The hit series about final goodbyes between the dead and the living across borders comes to the big screen. Angel Hearse receives a wave of international repatriation requests: a couple in Mexico in a movie-like romance, a baby, a man in a wheelchair on a world journey, an American star and his secret love, and Nami, who heads to Mexico after news her lover is alive. Will miracle reunions await?
1634479.title: Angel Flight THE MOVIE

1634508.synopsis: Thirty years ago, a prominent zamindar family resided in Bangalore, consisting of Maari and Dr. Mamtha. This period marked the advent of IT and biotech companies entering Bangalore, juxtaposed with the city's notorious underworld activity
1634508.title: Surya Power of Love

1634681.synopsis: Few sporting events hold the cultural weight of the Sydney to Hobart. Every Boxing Day, as the Cricket Test breaks for lunch, millions of Australians turn their attention to the start of the Great Race. For days, the nation follows the fleet into one of the world’s most treacherous bodies of water — Bass Strait — where shifting weather systems can turn elite competition into a fight for survival.
1634681.title: True South

1634949.synopsis: An unprecedented, behind-the-scenes glimpse at the man who built the inimitable empire of comedy, shaping television and culture for generations. The documentary features exclusive footage, archival treasures, and candid interviews with the show’s most iconic cast members and writers including Tina Fey, Maya Rudolph, John Mulaney, Andy Samberg, Conan O’Brien, Chris Rock and many more.
1634949.title: Lorne

1635086.synopsis: Three eccentric brothers maintain their "no women, no marriage" rule at their garage, but a return sparks fresh chaos. As old habits clash with new troubles, the iconic trio finds their world hilariously spiraling out of control.
1635086.title: Punha Ekda Sade Made 3

1635161.synopsis: Three gold miners searching for riches find a forgotten town. To survive the night, they must obey its bizarre rules, where every mistake is fatal.
1635161.title: Sundown

1635276.synopsis: Five eccentric dog owners seek help in dealing with their four-legged friends. Their last hope: an intensive course with the charismatic and legendary dog trainer Nodon in the Tyrolean mountains.
1635276.title: Eat Pray Bark

1635343.synopsis: When a student secretly living out of her car is confronted by a watchful security guard, survival and compassion collide.
1635343.title: Squata Locks

1635529.synopsis: Chanan Singh returns to his village after being dismissed from the royal palace, leading to a conflict with the crown over dignity and revolution.
1635529.title: Bambukat 2

1635591.synopsis: In Taliban-controlled Afghanistan, where women are denied the right to study, work, and speak freely, a group of young women risk their lives to form a secret reading circle.
1635591.title: The Secret Reading Club of Kabul

1636092.synopsis: A disgraced cop gets one last shot at redemption by busting a major black money ring. The twist? His targets aren't typical criminals but women and children concealing something far more sinister than financial crimes.
1636092.title: DSP Dev 2

1636147.synopsis: Featuring the parallel stories of a supersize building project and a jaw-dropping archaeological adventure, Rome Underground takes viewers on an immersive journey deep under the Eternal City — revealing how the construction of a 26-kilometer subway line through Rome has literally unearthed some of the most important discoveries of the modern age.
1636147.title: Rome Underground

1636421.synopsis: A reclusive heiress, bound by blood and burden, invites seven distant relatives to her decaying manor with whispers of inheritance. Beneath the promise lies a quiet cruelty- a gauntlet of secrets, temptation, and ruin. As family bonds unravel, she watches, choosing not just a successor, but a soul willing to bear the curse she can no longer carry. One will inherit the family estate, but only the heiress knows the hefty price they'll pay.
1636421.title: The Executor

1636593.synopsis: Cisco and Cheska, a long-term couple, embark on a final "break-up trip" to decide whether to let go or fight for their relationship after years of growing apart due to conflicting ambitions.
1636593.title: Us in the End

1636741.synopsis: When a successful ad agent and perpetual bachelorette obtains the name of her "true love" from a magical billboard she is forced to deal with her friends obsessions' to find her Mr. Right.

1636918.synopsis: This eye-opening documentary follows six couples with unexplained infertility as they lower their exposure to plastics in hopes it helps them conceive.
1636918.title: The Plastic Detox

1637046.synopsis: Go inside the pressure cooker of Australia's Supercars Final. Chaos erupts, hearts broken and dreams are realised on the streets of Adelaide.
1637046.title: Supercars - Road to Glory

1637137.synopsis: Martin, a 16-year-old from Čučer-Sandevo, Macedonia, dreams of becoming a star as a professional gamer — an aspiration that conflicts with his mother’s wishes for him to have a traditional education. When his best friend, Dimitar, gets the opportunity to try out for Europe’s top eSports team, Dynasty, Martin eagerly embraces the chance to make his mark.
1637137.title: One More Game

1637286.synopsis: Dan and Doris both find themselves single in their 70s after their spouses of decades have passed away. After using an online dating service during the pandemic for older singles, they talk on the phone for three months and fall in love before meeting in person. Now living in Austin, Texas, and married for three years, the two wear lavish matching outfits, go out dancing several nights a week, and have an active sexual life rooted in both fantasy and intimacy. With a deep awareness of their mortality guiding their choices, Dan and Doris are not afraid to show up in the world as their true selves, disregarding cultural norms for how older people should look, love, and move through the world.
1637286.title: Forcefield of Love

1637319.synopsis: Filmed in front of a live studio audience and hosted by Alex Cooper of 'Call Her Daddy' fame, Miley Cyrus reflects on the creation and impact of the series with never-before-seen archival footage, all the while interacting and reminiscing on some of the show's most memorable sets 'brought back to life' — including the Stewart family living room and the legendary Hannah Montana closet.
1637319.title: Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special

1637367.synopsis: Pushed beyond fear and silence, a woman kills the man who tried to exploit her and buries his body to escape her past. But when the police reopen the case, the grave is empty. With no body and too many secrets, suspicion deepens, truth blurs, and a haunting question remains, who moved the dead, and why?
1637367.title: Udd Da Teer

1637569.synopsis: KAT CRIME: TALES OF THE OCCULT follows Kat, the driven host of a struggling true-crime podcast, who drags her influencer friend Deana into a dangerous investigation involving a suspected witch coven accused of murder.
1637569.title: Kat Crime: Tales of the Occult

1637579.synopsis: A popular filmmaker sets out to make another movie when a filmmaking rival brings a curse upon the set. The cast soon become their characters and romance turns up in unusual places. Chaos is everywhere, battles erupt and it's a race against the clock to lift the love spell.
1637579.title: Love Spell

1637621.synopsis: Love, ambition and legacy collide under an unrelenting public spotlight throughout John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette's relationship and tragic deaths in the 1990s.
1637621.title: John and Carolyn: Love, Beauty and Loss

1637631.synopsis: The Grammy Award-winning British soul icon performs a celebratory concert at The Venetian in Las Vegas three decades after the release of his self-titled album Seal and eponymous follow up Seal II. Joined by longtime producer Trevor Horn, he performs a set highlighted by classic chart-topping anthems Crazy, Future Love Paradise, Killer and Kiss From a Rose, as well as a few surprises. Directed by Keirda Bahruth (Hardcore Devo) and with intimate interviews interspersed throughout, it’s a stunning film that shows this extraordinary artist at the top of his performance game.
1637631.title: Seal: Purpose

1638355.synopsis: An exploration of the caged heart, what happens when fear suffocates expression, and how  love unravels in silence as a result.
1638355.title: Fresco

1638677.synopsis: After the events of the first films, Rachel, the lone survivor of Aladdin, finds the lamp once more haunting her as she attends a therapy retreat. She must protect a new set of friends as the lamp's evil plan to grant three deadly wishes begins all over again.
1638677.title: Aladdin's Revenge

1638737.synopsis: They say never meet your heroes, how about never meet your friends heroes! An action hero from an old movie takes vengeance on punk teens.
1638737.title: Horny For Justice IV

1638741.synopsis: This documentary-drama film follows Lance Sgt. Haane Manahi DCM of B Company, 28th Māori Battalion, a soldier of extraordinary courage, whose actions proved pivotal in the 1943 battle for the fortified summit of Takrouna, Tunisia.
1638741.title: Man of Valor

1638841.synopsis: In the depths of despair, a young man travels to an empty beach in the hopes of reuniting with his lover, Maria, who inexplicably disappeared the year earlier.
1638841.title: The Ocean Washed Over Your Grave

1638927.synopsis: A grieving widower, resistant to his late wife's dog, slowly reconnects with the outside world through Tilly's persistent companionship.
1638927.title: Tilly

1638948.synopsis: Made miserable by the state of the world, two teenage lovers decide to skip school and spend the day at home together.
1638948.title: Slackadelia

1639000.synopsis: In this emotional interview, the late actor and ALS advocate Eric Dane shared his final message for the world — knowing it would not air until his death.
1639000.title: Famous Last Words: Eric Dane

1639341.synopsis: A recently separated man newly living alone discovers that he is sleepwalking at night, and as he records his activities, he discovers questionable behaviors and the presence of another mysterious figure.
1639341.title: Go to Sleep

163937.synopsis: Rainer’s landmark film is a meditation on ambivalence that plays with cliché and the conventions of soap opera while telling the story of a woman whose sexual dissatisfaction masks an enormous anger.
163937.title: Film About a Woman Who…

1639529.synopsis: Two bad girls at a private academy for wayward girls receive help from a mysterious inspirational teacher who helps reform them.
1639529.title: Bad Girl Sunday School

1639763.synopsis: A cunning but lazy man fakes his corrupt father's death to take over his police position, but chaos ensues when his father suddenly awakens from a coma.
1639763.title: Viyaah Kartaare Da

1639960.synopsis: On the day of Frankenstein’s Monster’s wedding, villagers riot and kill him. His bride escapes, vows revenge on the townsfolk responsible, and eventually resurrects the Monster – leading a trail of blood in her wake.
1639960.title: Frankenstein's Bride

1640165.synopsis: During a casual game of Scattergories, four friends discover that the most dangerous thing in the room isn't time, guns, or bad language- it's how well they know each other.
1640165.title: F**k Face

1640340.synopsis: Maa Jaye is a powerful Punjabi film that revolves around the deep bond of brotherhood. It tells the story of brothers bound by love, loyalty, and shared struggles, as they face life's challenges together. Rooted in emotions and family values, the film highlights sacrifice, responsibility, and the strength that comes from standing by one another through every test of time.
1640340.title: Bhootan Wala Khooh

1641315.synopsis: Drawn Back to Chennai by an Unexpected Call From His Former Lover, Dheeren Travels From Mumbai and Checks Into a Secluded Office Guest House. Soon After His Arrival, Disturbing and Inexplicable Events Begin to Unfold Within Its Walls. Night After Night, Dheeren is Plagued by Vivid Dreams—fragments of Memories That Eerily Mirror His Own Past and Unresolved Relationship.  As the Line Between Dreams and Reality Begins to Blur, Dheeren Realizes These Visions Are Not Random. Each Dream is a Clue, Slowly Pulling Him Toward a Buried Truth Connected to His Ex-lover’s Fate. Trapped Between Guilt, Fear, and the Supernatural, Dheeren Must Confront His Past to Uncover What Truly Happened to Her—before the Guest House Claims Him as Its Next Secret.
1641315.title: Fourth Floor

1641319.synopsis: Brandon Beckett and Agent Zero lead a rescue mission in Costa Verde when their friends are taken hostage.
1641319.title: Sniper: No Nation

1641629.synopsis: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.
1641629.title: You+Me - Against the World

1641817.synopsis: Mark Normand turns married life, fatherhood and hot-button topics into rapid-fire punchlines in this witty free-for-all where nothing is off limits.
1641817.title: Mark Normand: None Too Pleased

1641961.synopsis: This documentary traces the life of Lamar Odom, from his rise to NBA fame and marriage to Khloé Kardashian to his near-fatal overdose in a Nevada brothel.
1641961.title: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom

1641962.synopsis: Magnus Carlsen, widely regarded as the greatest chess player of all time, is challenged by Hans Niemann, a rising star who capitalizes on the meteoric growth of online chess. Niemann’s ascension culminated in an epic, controversy-shrouded victory over Carlsen at the 2022 Sinquefield Cup, which eventually led to allegations and revelations of cheating. Determined to clear his name, Niemann fights his way back to the top of the chess world, setting the stage for a high-stakes rematch with Carlsen in 2024.
1641962.title: Untold: Chess Mates

1641965.synopsis: Volatile players. Criminal charges. National headlines. Portland's championship-caliber NBA team implodes spectacularly in this unflinching documentary.
1641965.title: Untold: Jail Blazers

1641966.synopsis: A retired Olympic equestrian takes on a new dressage student at his idyllic farm in New Jersey. Over time, tensions mount between the two, leading to 911 calls, cryptic social media posts, and accusations of spying. The feud culminates in a shocking act of violence and a trial that rocked the prestigious and sophisticated world of dressage.
1641966.title: Untold: The Shooting at Hawthorne Hill

1642114.synopsis: Shocking deaths hit a small town after a troubled teen moves in with a picture-perfect foster family and clashes with their angelic daughter.
1642114.title: Bad Apples

1642373.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of Hollywood, Homeys follows four unhoused artists in Los Angeles fighting to survive while chasing their creative dreams.
1642373.title: Homeys

1642375.synopsis: Two sisters, Silvia and Susanna, are divided by a deep conflict. Susanna, considered unstable but convinced of her own clarity, accuses Silvia of having an incestuous relationship with their father, shattering the family's balance. Her provocative and violent actions make her socially dangerous and force her to disappear. Meanwhile, her accusations contaminate everyone's relationships, leaving behind an ambiguous reality in which the truth appears painful and uncertain.
1642375.title: Horror Vacui

1642463.synopsis: World-renowned motivational speaker and author Tony Robbins sits down with superstar, Jon Bon Jovi. Enjoy this intimate conversation between friends with exclusive performances from Bon Jovi.
1642463.title: Bon Jovi Forever: A Tony Robbins Special

1642619.synopsis: When a boy from a broken home steals a peach from his neighbour's tree, he sets off a clash that will change him forever.
1642619.title: Pītiti

1642650.synopsis: A disillusioned Iraq War veteran is framed for a murder by a beautiful social media influencer. He must track down the only person who can testify on his behalf: a former sex worker on the run from a murderous gangster.
1642650.title: East Bay Confidential
