The stories collected intertwine in a unique creative expression, transforming personal narratives into a collective and empowering experience.
1720280.title: Human Soul

1720289.synopsis: Four boys flee home on a journey of self-discovery, acceptance, and freedom.
1720289.title: The One, The Other And Those From Beyond

1720486.synopsis: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.
1720486.title: Lilo & Scratch

1720716.synopsis: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.
1720716.title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You

1720758.synopsis: A coast-to-coast event exploring Disney Parks and attractions as a portal through which America's greatest stories, triumphs and traditions are celebrated.
1720758.title: Disney Celebrates America: The Pursuit of Happiness

1720899.synopsis: Poetic doc on young queer people of colour navigating identity, freedom, and nighttime sanctuary in Sydney.
1720899.title: Queering Sydney

1720907.synopsis: Why the AFL was the last major sports league without an openly queer male player; explores inclusion in Australian football culture.
1720907.title: The Last Closet

1721076.synopsis: Grace and Bels live together, do everything together, have slept together – but Grace is queer, and Bels is not, so when faced with Bels’s new boyfriend, how long before she just loses it?
1721076.title: Full Fat

1721329.title: Paranorías: Los Archivos Perdidos Del Dr. Romanoski

1721352.synopsis: Pastor Edmond Henry's appears to have the perfect life. But when a mysterious murder shatters the calm, his darkest secret is exposed, unleashing a chain of events that unintentionally destroy his family and everything he fought to protect.
1721352.title: Shattered Silence: Imitation of a Perfect Life

1721367.synopsis: A reformed street figure risks everything when he tries to help an old friend fresh out of prison, only to discover that some debts don't disappear; they come back to collect.
1721367.title: Homage

1721600.synopsis: Journey into the lives of Father's fighting to be with their children. As they face an uphill battle against a biased system pushing a Fatherless agenda. Wrongfully Accused, False Accusations, Child Support and Meritless Restraining Orders
1721600.title: Deadbeat

1721856.synopsis: Ray, a former gymnast-turned-pageant winner leaves behind the comfort of fame and privilege to take part in the Spring Revolution against Myanmar’s military dictatorship.
1721856.title: Ray

1721886.synopsis: A father, his son and a billionaire find themselves face to face with the relentless fury of nature.
1721886.title: Natural Selection

1721888.synopsis: A short documentary following C.O.F.F.I.N from their beginnings as teenagers on Sydney’s Northern Beaches to becoming one of Australia’s most respected contemporary rock’n’roll bands.
1721888.title: 10,000 Miles From Oslo

1722167.synopsis: Mickey and friends use their new farm vehicles to build the Fairest Farm Fair ever — hoping Daisy’s cowgirl idol, Lasso Lucy, will stop by for a visit.
1722167.title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+: Mickey's Country Farm

1722506.synopsis: In a future where gifted children are turned into weapons, Ava escapes the Blackwell Institute, desperate for freedom. Hunted by Bo, Ava must find freedom before the forces that created her destroy everything she's fighting for.
1722506.title: Flicker

1722652.synopsis: A meditation on time and being alive, PRESENT is the follow-up comedy special to Gavin Matts: Progression (2023).
1722652.title: Gavin Matts: present

1722713.synopsis: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.
1722713.title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain

1722722.synopsis: Leeds, 2034. A charismatic yet violent student rules the pupils of an all-boys school through a combination of menacing charm and sheer thuggery. At the end of the academic year, they gather for a school photo, which quickly descends into riotous, pugilistic celebration under the boy's leadership.
1722722.title: GENER8ION: STORM starring Yung Lean

1722897.synopsis: When the block heats up in Atlanta, Bishop, Tez, Poncho, and the crew must navigate love, money, and loyalty. In Da' Partments, everybody's got a hustle - and nothing stays quiet for long.
1722897.title: Da ’Partments 2

1722922.synopsis: A pirate looking for a place to fit in accidentally joins a club of cannibals.
1722922.title: Cannon Ball/Cannibal

1722960.synopsis: A young couple try to save their marriage after being delivered a file from the future detailing their impending divorce.
1722960.title: Hindsight Services

1722965.synopsis: Eli Manning recruits WNBA superstar Sabrina Ionescu to go undercover at her alma mater, the University of Oregon. Sabrina transforms into Jennifer Scone, an enthusiastic Ducks fan who's attending her first basketball game. She fools coaches, mingles with fans, and shocks the crowd at halftime.
1722965.title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Sabrina Ionescu

1723068.synopsis: In Mexico’s Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean’s most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant in these seas, hammerhead numbers have plummeted, making sightings increasingly rare. Bertie investigates what’s driving the hammerhead decline, and how protected waters offer hope for the future. His journey culminates in a rare and unforgettable encounter that shines a light on the future of one of the world’s most famous sharks.
1723068.title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory

1723075.synopsis: Set in one of the world's most closely watched wine regions, Stem & Barrel is an intimate, cinematic documentary that follows three acclaimed Napa Valley wineries through a single harvest season a defining moment that touches every part of the work, from vineyard to cellar to guest experience. With rare access to the people behind the process, the film reveals how each winery moves through the season in its own way balancing craft, hospitality, mentorship, and legacy while upholding a world-class reputation built by generations before them. Across early mornings in the vineyard, long days in the cellar, and moments shared with guests, each piece of the season is connected and every decision shapes what comes next. Because in Napa Valley, harvest isn’t just about making wine it’s about carrying something forward.
1723075.title: Stem & Barrel: Napa Valley

1723460.synopsis: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.
1723460.title: A Toxic Love Story

1723486.synopsis: Four twisted tales where technology turns, strangers become monsters, and the darkness outside the door is the least of your problems. An AI that won't let go. A mind unravelling online. A Christmas Eve that ends in screaming. A ghost who makes the rules.
1723486.title: Glitch

1723570.synopsis: Is an ex-best friend the worst ex? Can dating apps save democracy? What's with NYPD merch? Mary Beth Barone has all the answers in this witty special.
1723570.title: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain

1723693.synopsis: When a spontaneous kiss propels Janie and Alex's quirky friendship into a secret love affair, they are forced to confront the truth about their sexualities amidst the conservative ideologies of their hometown.
1723693.title: Whistle Down Wind

1723911.synopsis: Australian coins provide a set of instructions that question how to live in a capitalist colonial society in the time of climate uncertainty. Head or Tails was shot on a hand wound Bolex following self-imposed instructions over a single roll of film. Setting the focus to close range, I let the flip of a coin decide which direction the camera “walked”. The camera, fixed to a mono-pod, strides through the landscape till the film wind or path runs out.
1723911.title: Heads or Tails?

1723990.synopsis: A motley crew of para ice hockey skaters fight to keep their grassroots sporting club on the rink in this stirring, often hilarious documentary.
1723990.title: Hard as Puck

1723994.synopsis: This is the story of a band that grew up but never grew apart. Jebediah's thirty-year journey is a celebration of friendship, creativity, and staying connected against the odds.
1723994.title: Jebediah: Are We OK?

1724020.synopsis: A mute young woman, Nora, awakens into a surreal domestic prison, a seemingly idyllic beachside cottage under the suffocating control of a charismatic but sinister Fisherman and his increasingly unstable partner.
1724020.title: The Tide Turns

1724077.synopsis: How do you separate a Melbourne-born Oz music treasure and cosmopolitan star from a resilient woman? Follow the threads of her story, in her own words.
1724077.title: Tina Arena: Unravel Me

1724711.synopsis: In 1947, in a small town in New Zealand, rationing essential goods became a way of life after the war. Helen McCrae, a Middle-aged woman's life disintegrates as she is waiting for news of her son Adam from the front lines.
1724711.title: On the Edge of Hope

1724782.synopsis: If you’ve watched someone brush their teeth, chances are you live with them or you’re in love with them.  A collage by Greer Clemens of scenes from movies and TV shows where people brush their teeth.
1724782.title: Silence As Romance: Brushing Your Teeth

1724848.synopsis: At a picture-perfect wedding, a bride and groom walk the aisle with smiles and secrets. Through flashbacks and inner thoughts, their love story unfolds-messy, tender, and anything but traditional. A romantic comedy about timing, honesty, and choosing love, even when it's complicated.
1724848.title: Down the Aisle

1725099.synopsis: Bea has always known she was born to perform. But when a pandemic shuts down her school's music program and bans singing altogether, even her boundless ambition hits a wall. Undeterred, she convinces her friends to form an underground show choir — and what starts as an act of rebellion slowly becomes something much bigger: a reminder that music isn't a privilege, it's a lifeline. Funny, heartfelt, and packed with original songs, Plan Bea is an Australian musical feature film that proves you can't stop joy.
1725099.title: Plan Bea

1725116.synopsis: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she's tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner's clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.
1725116.title: Simpsley

1725133.synopsis: In a suffocating, cold, paper-filled space, a young man named Pelikan produces a  golden paperclip from his body and a glowing force takes everything from him,  revealing the cost of being noticed by an endless consuming system.
1725133.title: Human Resources

1725411.synopsis: House hunting in London has already pushed Barry and Alex to the edge, but when they meet an eccentric landlord at a viewing gone off the rails, they’re forced to ask: is this madness or just the rental market?
1725411.title: Break Clause

1725502.synopsis: Six diverse professional dancers navigate the dance of life as they balance the rhythms of motherhood and their demanding careers, unveiling the joys, struggles, and triumphs of pursuing their dreams.
1725502.title: Mama Dancers

1725567.synopsis: A new feature-length surf film featuring 100% never-before-seen waves, taken from over 300 hours of footage shot during the two-year journey to make "South To Sian".
1725567.title: Sian Sessions

1725760.synopsis: Jing An reconnects with her parents during their short visit to Sydney. Through small gestures and everyday moments, the film observes the tenderness and distance within a family.
1725760.title: Then the Wind Stops

1725959.synopsis: From a quiet academy hopeful to one of football's most prolific strikers, this documentary traces Harry Kane's determined rise through setbacks, loan spells, and relentless self-belief. Blending personal interviews, unseen training-ground moments, and career-defining matches, it reveals how discipline, mentality, and leadership transformed him from an underestimated youngster into a global sporting icon.
1725959.title: Harry Kane: Against the Odds

1726465.synopsis: Booze, Blood and Gators. A broke-down swamper with a bottle in one hand and a blade in the other learns the hard way that rage will rot your soul.
1726465.title: Gator Face

1727412.synopsis: An emotional family drama about a young woman who lacks the support of her family. She dreams of finding a loving husband who will cherish her, help her build a beautiful life, and give her the freedom to live on her own terms.
1727412.title: Behuli

1727563.synopsis: In Assam, 14-year-old Apu embarks on a desperate quest to rescue his beloved dog, Momo, after he is kidnapped. Elsewhere, in Bihar, a devoted dog named Oscar sets out on a perilous journey to find his kidnapped owner, a 15-year-old child labourer. As their journeys unfold, it becomes clear that the two kidnappings may be connected to a larger, sinister plan.
1727563.title: Ohh My Dog

1727869.synopsis: Paani follows a heartfelt story of two brothers torn apart by militancy, loss, love, and painful social traditions.
1727869.title: Paani

1728002.synopsis: Explores the rise, impact, and enduring mythology of Aziz Shavershian – “Zyzz” – the unlikely internet icon whose transformation from anonymous teenager to global symbol of fitness culture reshaped how a generation defines influencers, identity, and self-invention.
1728002.title: Poster Boy: Becoming Zyzz

1728056.synopsis: In a bold 28-day experiment, comedian Mo Gilligan tours the UK and US on a fried chicken diet to uncover the impact of the craving — and industry behind it.
1728056.title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy

1728105.synopsis: While recording vocal takes alone in a deserted carpark, an anxious singer confronts the shadows outside and the fear within.
1728105.title: Singer

1728113.synopsis: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.
1728113.title: KATSEYE: Wild Hearts

1728503.synopsis: Former Victoria detective Narelle Fraser investigated some of Australia’s highest profile crimes. Her easy manner allowed her to gain rapport with many perpetrators, leading to their convictions… but it all came at a price. The constant daily exposure to horrific crime had a cumulative effect on Narelle’s mental health. She hid the effects for 27 years, but after suffering panic and amnesia, she received a diagnosis of PTSD, which forced her discharge from the Police. THE POLICEWOMAN illustrates the crimes that caused her descent into hell, and the battle to claw her way out. Narelle’s positive outcome in this true crime feature will demystify the stigma of mental health and speak to millions of first responders around the world.
1728503.title: The Policewoman

1728564.synopsis: A look at the artists and Imagineers whose creativity shaped Disney’s newest addition.
1728564.title: The Magic Behind Island Tower At Disney’s Polynesian Villas & Bungalows

1728629.synopsis: Kaka, branded as a curse since birth by his fellow villagers goes on to win a lottery ticket. And that changes everyone's behaviour towards him. But there's a twist in the story which only Kaka knows.
1728629.title: Kaka Jamm Peya

1728954.synopsis: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?
1728954.title: My Grandfather Charles Manson

1729196.synopsis: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.
1729196.title: Dread

1729399.synopsis: This autobiographical experimental documentary explores the story behind Ben Duffy’s first film, We Are Skateboarders, and the 15-year mental health journey that followed. Ben was 19 and living with undiagnosed bipolar disorder when he made the film. Although it became the second most-watched skateboarding documentary after Dogtown and Z-Boys, it was not a commercial success. As attention grew, Ben’s mental health deteriorated, forcing him to question the meaning of success in life and art. His healing began through therapy, where he confronted trauma, shame, guilt, and complex PTSD linked to the filmmaking experience. The documentary captures his transformation from immense pain toward catharsis, self-love, and compassion. It is a raw and inspiring exploration of resilience, creativity, and mental health.
1729399.title: We Are Skateboarders: A Mental Health Transformation

1729559.synopsis: A celebrated composer facing death, his working-class neighbour facing jail, and a sharp New York writer form an unlikely alliance over one charged weekend in Far North Queensland.
1729559.title: Storm Bird

1730324.synopsis: After the ending of the hit Netflix series “Heartstopper”, this special combines never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage, cast and crew interviews, larger cultural commentary, and fan input.
1730324.title: Heartstopper: Ending on a Hi

1730482.synopsis: A queer and trans found family create a death ritual that weaves together the inextricable experiences of grief and eros, community and country.
1730482.title: HARD / SOFT / STICKY / WET: A Joyous Death

1730690.synopsis: Go behind the scenes of the all-new Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets at Disney's Hollywood Studios at Walt Disney World Resort in Florida. John Stamos, joined by "The Muppets" Studio Creative Director Dani Iglesias, gets an inside look at the reimagined attraction, packed with Muppet humor, music, and hidden details. Along the way, they meet Kermit the Frog, plus Animal and Sergeant Floyd Pepper from The Electric Mayhem as they reveal how the coaster's story, energy, and soundtrack come together. Experience a wild, music-fueled adventure that blends thrills, comedy, and classic Muppet charm. Now open at Disney's Hollywood Studios.
1730690.title: Disney+ Insider: Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets

1730721.synopsis: Jack moves into a share house. Things quickly spiral.
1730721.title: Dean

1730775.synopsis: Two wealthy space tourists embark on the trip of a lifetime. Literally.
1730775.title: Space Turd

1730968.synopsis: Fragments of recreated archival footage depicts daily life along the Mekong River in the countryside of Cambodia. Cooking, planting rice, children at school and crossing the river is captured on Super 8, yet the fictional time period is unknown. An imagined flash flood submerges everything. “Where is the old house? Do you go through here?” A voice repeats over and over again. All is not lost as water drops ripple open portals of memories that reemerge from the depths of the river.
1730968.title: Lost In The Water

1730999.synopsis: Where do we go when we die? After losing his brother, a young man sets off on a motorcycle through the Himalayas, seeking a cure for his broken heart but finding something far more unexpected.
1730999.title: Higher Calling

1731494.synopsis: Go behind the scenes of Christopher Nolan's mythic action epic, The Odyssey. This special documentary explores the monumental undertaking of adapting Homer’s foundational saga for the big screen, charting a grueling 91-day principal photography schedule across six countries. From the revolutionary use of brand-new IMAX film technology to the massive coordination of over 5,300 custom-designed costumes, discover how a star-studded cast led by Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Anne Hathaway brought the dangerous, timeless world of ancient Greek gods and monsters to life.
1731494.title: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic

1731594.synopsis: In the year 2073, where all copies of films have been lost in a sea of AI-generated replicas, two detectives seek out the original copy of 'The Matrix'.
1731594.title: How Do You Remember The Matrix?

1731694.synopsis: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.
1731694.title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian

1731954.title: Libera nos: Il trionfo sul male

1732051.synopsis: Swing through twenty years of Spider-Man history—from Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield to Tom Holland. Explore the evolution of the iconic suits and stunts, follow Tom's journey into the mask, and get an exclusive look at Peter Parker's next chapter with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.
1732051.title: Generations: The Evolution of Spider-Man

1732097.synopsis: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.
1732097.title: Euphoria: A Look Back

1732324.synopsis: A middle-class man's carefully balanced life is turned upside down by unexpected challenges that test his dreams, relationships, and resilience. As he faces one setback after another, he discovers the true meaning of family, perseverance, and self-worth.
1732324.title: Mister Middle Class

1732489.synopsis: Stretching more than 5,600 kilometres across the country, the Dingo Fence stands as a symbol of one of Australia’s longest-running and most complex debates. On one side, livelihoods depend on protecting livestock. On the other, a native apex predator plays a vital role in the health of our ecosystems. On The Fence is a feature documentary that brings together graziers, scientists, First Nations voices and conservationists to explore the people, landscapes and ideas at the heart of this conversation. Rather than asking who is right or wrong, On The Fence asks a different question: are we willing to coexist with apex predators and learn from the mistakes of our past?
1732489.title: On the Fence

1732625.synopsis: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.
1732625.title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem

1732857.synopsis: Details how self-help guru Soulaire Allerai manipulated followers into financial and mental dependency through isolation and forced communal living. Former members describe the organization's promises of enlightenment masking a reality of strict control and abuse.
1732857.title: People Magazine Investigates: The Cult of the Soulful Journey

1733915.synopsis: When reigniting memories from his past, a lowly drifter come face to face with his deepest secret.
1733915.title: Skeleton

1734011.synopsis: An aspiring fashion designer fights to prove himself against his father's wishes. Just as love enters his life, a mysterious disappearance sets him on an unforgettable journey into a hidden world where his true destiny awaits.
1734011.title: Raja The Raja

1734152.synopsis: While patrolling a restricted zone, Agent MU-0213 is ordered to track down and execute a deserter. During a deadly confrontation, he discovers that his opponent is the fugitive agent MU-1225, known as Tristan. Cornered and seemingly doomed, MU-0213 is spared when Tristan asks him a single, unexpected question: "Do you have a name?" The question awakens fragmented memories, forcing MU-0213 to question everything he believes about himself. But what is Tristan really after, and why would a skilled sniper spare his enemy when he had the perfect chance to kill him?
1734152.title: The Executor

1734379.synopsis: After surviving a mass shooting at her office, a former mean exec attends a secluded therapy retreat in the hopes of recovering, but when odd occurrences keep happening, she begins to suspect that something else is lurking in the shadows.
1734379.title: A Mind in Chaos

1735270.synopsis: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.
1735270.title: Premada Oorali

1735283.synopsis: Five estranged college friends reunite years later when an invitation brings them back to campus. As they revive a forgotten youth festival, old bonds return, buried emotions resurface, and their shared past begins to shape their present.
1735283.title: Yaar Jigree Kasooti Degree

1735460.synopsis: In a remote town, a 14-year-old misfit teenager becomes manipulated by a mysterious, disfigured old man.
1735460.title: Hide

1736062.synopsis: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.
1736062.title: Disney Worldbuilders

1736415.synopsis: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.
1736415.title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On

1736908.synopsis: A parolee determined to stay out of trouble finds a duffel bag full of gangsters' cash in his trunk and must decide whether to return it to protect his loved ones or flee to save himself.
1736908.title: Last Reckoning

1736916.synopsis: Prediction markets let anyone bet on anything, from the World Cup to alien invasions. "Instadocs" investigates the explosive rise of global betting.
1736916.title: Instadocs: The Prediction Games

1736993.synopsis: On another world much like our own, a young Samoyed named Seamus Alessandro O'Shaughnessy discovers a lost girl named Dakota who has unfathomable magic! Seamus must overcome great challenges both physical & emotional alongside his best friend Carolina Oriqueda Campbell Keeshond-Seal to save Great Canyon City from the Menace known as The Blurred Blaze! Can our heroes defeat their foes while simultaneously protecting an innocent child in the process? And who exactly is The Blurred Blaze?
1736993.title: Thera: The Inverted Planet

1737740.synopsis: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.
1737740.title: Fresh Meat

1738070.synopsis: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.
1738070.title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour

1738701.synopsis: Patriot Southern Command under General Nathaniel Greene organizes militias for a push against the British.
1738701.title: Rise and Fight: The Battle of Hobkirk's Hill

1738735.synopsis: After his domineering mother dies, reclusive farmer Ed Gein descends into madness, hearing her voice urging him to punish sinful women and turning his home into a house of horrors.
1738735.title: Ed Gein: The House of Horrors

1738843.synopsis: Actor and comedian Ken Jeong and Grammy-nominated artist Rei Ami use the global power of K-Pop to transform perceptions of sharks across East Asia and beyond.
1738843.title: K-Pop Shark Heroes

1739113.synopsis: Dee rebounds from one, funny failed date to the next, in the search for Mr Right. If only she could see that her best friend is right there all along - it's obvious, right?
1739113.title: Rebound

1739186.synopsis: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.
1739186.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young

1739202.synopsis: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.
1739202.title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly

1739206.synopsis: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.
1739206.title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool

1739317.synopsis: In four thought-provoking sci-fi stories, people confront altered memories, forbidden love, artificial lifetimes and extraordinary powers. As time, identity and reality begin to shift, each must decide what truly makes a life worth living.
1739317.title: Echoes of Tomorrow

1739614.synopsis: Off Nova Scotia's coast is rumored to be the elusive Big Rose, a female great white shark believed to be one of largest predators in the North Atlantic. Using innovative tagging technology and daring field ops, a team attempts to find this ocean giant.
1739614.title: Invasion of the Mega Sharks

1739619.synopsis: Shark attack survivor Paul de Gelder and predator specialist Rosie Moore head to Jupiter, Florida to uncover what's fueling a surge in bull shark aggression. Testing weather, prey and human behavior, they build toward one explosive final demonstration.
1739619.title: Bull Shark Dinner Bell

1739626.synopsis: A new report of a 15-foot mako shark off the coast of Mexico shatters conventional wisdom on how large these sharks can grow. A team of experts heads to the Pacific Ocean to track down this mega shark and find the biggest mako in the world.
1739626.title: Biggest Mako on Earth

1739628.synopsis: In New Zealand's waters, great white "houses" battle for dominance. Experts risk it all to reveal the bloodlines that determine their allegiances.
1739628.title: House of Sharks

1739632.synopsis: The special takes viewers deep into prehistoric waters to explore the ancient ancestors of today's sharks. Using animation, the episode highlights some of the most feared prehistoric ocean creatures, including the Dunkleosteus, the buzzsaw shark (Helicoprion), and the scissor-toothed shark (Edestus).
1739632.title: Jurassic Sharks

1739635.synopsis: This special investigates the chilling phenomenon of great white sharks washing ashore with their livers extracted with surgical precision. To decode the orca's "kill sequence," the team travels to the Strait of Gibraltar, where orcas have developed a highly organized tactic of ramming sailboats, crippling rudders, and even sinking vessels.
1739635.title: Jaws vs. Orca

1739638.synopsis: Forrest Galante explores America's strangest alien sharks in celebration of the nation's 250th anniversary.
1739638.title: Alien Sharks: Untamed America

1739640.synopsis: Josh Gates explores Scotland's Stronsay Beast, the earliest known shark attack and how the USS Indianapolis led to history's deadliest attack.
1739640.title: Expedition Unknown: Shark Secrets

1739641.synopsis: The team investigates disturbing reports of aggressive mutant sharks in the Marshall Islands, exploring whether the region's atomic past is to blame.
1739641.title: Expedition X: Atomic Sharks

1739643.synopsis: Experts analyze shark encounters caught on camera, using forensics to review bite marks and behavior patterns as they wonder: What shark attacked?
1739643.title: What Shark Attacked?

1739644.synopsis: Experts attempt to train great white sharks using cues and challenges to test learning, memory, and decision-making in the wild.
1739644.title: How to Train a Great White

1739647.synopsis: In a world first, a cliff diver Molly Carlson attempts a 50-foot dive off a helicopter into a floating cage surrounded by a shark feeding frenzy.
1739647.title: Ultimate Shark Dive

1739649.synopsis: A scientist hunts for a possible radioactive shark killer near an old nuclear dumping ground in New York that's ringed with makos and great whites.
1739649.title: Sharkzilla Takes New York

1739651.synopsis: Four shark fanatics reveal their obsessions, including an intimate relationship, a massive collection, and a body covered in sharks.
1739651.title: My Strange Shark Addiction

1739654.synopsis: Dr. Craig O'Connell and Aliah Banchik deploy state-of-the-art tech as they try to capture the thresher's deadly tail whip on film in the Philippines.
1739654.title: Thresher Shark: Stun to Kill

1739655.synopsis: Ben is a hired assassin who works for a mastermind serial killer, Ian. But when his boss is murdered, Ben has to confront Ian's killer and take vengeance upon him.
1739655.title: THE BEAN

1739960.synopsis: An investigative documentary exploring long-standing and newly detailed allegations of sexual misconduct, grooming, and criminal sexual conduct against Oscar-winning actor and Thirty Seconds to Mars frontman Jared Leto.
1739960.title: Jared Leto: Hollywood's Dark Secret

1740133.synopsis: Returning to his hometown after serving time for manslaughter, “Maniac” faces an unpaid debt— along with an unwelcome spiritual presence.
1740133.title: Blak magic

1740313.synopsis: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.
1740313.title: Stamptown

1740332.synopsis: A 30-year-old British-Mexican comic creator visits her parents to secure a deposit for her first flat, only to find help won’t come because her mother, 51, is pregnant.
1740332.title: Chasing Home

1740362.synopsis: Beyond Borders Patagonia follows a group of filmmakers, surfers and snowboarders on a journey into Chile's final frontiers, in search of undiscovered waves and hidden mountains in the Andes, with no blueprint and everything at stake.
1740362.title: Beyond Borders Patagonia

1740387.synopsis: An ex-Army man takes on a contract to rescue a young woman stranded in Mumbai and bring her safely back to Nepal. What begins as a straightforward rescue mission soon turns into a dangerous and unexpected journey.
1740387.title: Acharya

1740614.synopsis: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.
1740614.title: Newton's 3rd Law

1740844.synopsis: When the sacred Theyyam ritual demands the ultimate sacrifice from a young boy, his parents dare to challenge centuries-old beliefs. An emotional drama about faith, loss, and the courage to defy tradition
1740844.title: Paithallattam

1740877.synopsis: As a big storm approaches, Elmo and friends work together to get ready. After it passes, Sesame Street looks different — and everyone pitches in to help.
1740877.title: Storm on Sesame Street

1740937.synopsis: In a time when the visibility of LGBTQ+ people in Britain has never been higher, so too has the backlash. Guided by the beloved drag star, Copper Topp, Living Out Loud confronts the rising tide of homophobia and transphobia sweeping the UK, while celebrating the resilience and brilliance of the queer community.
1740937.title: Living Out Loud

1740989.synopsis: "IDOL" is a confessional piece by underground artist AQUAKEY. Set in the near future, the story follows Gleb Bykhovtsev—a rising star in the entertainment industry signed to a major label. Weary of relentless commercialism and censorship, Gleb disrupts the "Artist of the Year" awards ceremony where he was a nominee, triggering a downward spiral in his life. "IDOL" is a story about a life one would never wish to live. A non-linear narrative interweaves two parallel versions of Gleb’s existence: his dream—fantasies of the future—and his reality—memories of a sober past. Or is it the other way around? An independent, non-commercial, and genuinely raw, provocative auteur film by debut director Egor Kudinov.
1740989.title: IDOL

1741004.synopsis: Follows General William T. Sherman's 1865 Union push from Savannah, Georgia, into South Carolina. The film details the campaign's battlefield clashes at Broxton and River's Bridge, a rare Union cavalry defeat at Aiken, and the continued Union advance toward Columbia and North Carolina.
1741004.title: Sherman's March Through the Carolinas

1741201.synopsis: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?
1741201.title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​

1741223.synopsis: Guided by mysterious entities who claim to be family, Nikki is shown the haunting secrets of her town, her parents and friends. Her faith is put to the test and sends her spiraling down a path of insanity, for which there may be no escape.
1741223.title: Perfect Soul

1741346.synopsis: A husband's fight to save his wife from a demonic possession that began the moment the dybbuk box chose her as its next host.
1741346.title: Evil Follows

1741384.synopsis: A Stone Tape film inspired by the yellow fever epidemic in 19th century New Orleans, using analog camera techniques and contact microphones to excavate the material traces of trauma. Coined by archaeologist and parapsychologist T.C. Lethbridge, Stone Tape Theory posits that material objects record traumatic events of the past…and that they can be played back.
1741384.title: NECROPOLIS

1741770.synopsis: A mysterious visit to a grieving family pulls a young woman into a terrifying world of secrets, black magic, and haunting illusions. As disturbing events begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare, Kaamakhya finds herself trapped in a chilling chain of events rooted in a dark past that refuses to stay buried.
1741770.title: Karmakhya

1741784.title: The Apparition: final piece in The Ship trilogy

1742417.synopsis: Ahura is a wheelchair carrier who tries to escape at all costs, but finds Gymbia being a decisive presence on a stormy day.
1742417.title: Dias de Tempestade

1742441.synopsis: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.
1742441.title: V/H/S/MIXTAPE

1742483.synopsis: A delusional vampire takes it upon himself to rid his town of violence. To do so, he teams up with a couple of freshly turned vampires, a stubborn christian struggling to adjust to his new truth, and a rook who is quick to adapt to hers.
1742483.title: Biff the Human Slayer

1743237.synopsis: Deep in the wilderness, two best friends must learn to forgive and depend on each other more than ever when they stir up a group of dangerous locals.
1743237.title: Sweet Candy Peach

1743303.synopsis: Truth or Consequence is a concert film in which Amyl and The Sniffers perform country-influenced versions of their songs, two unreleased tracks, and a cover of the Slim Dusty classic 'Lights On The Hill'. It was recorded and filmed in front of an intimate and increasingly rowdy audience at El Coyote in Los Angeles, by the band's long-time collaborator, John Angus Stewart.
1743303.title: Truth Or Consequence

1743364.synopsis: A film of live music photographed at the famous El Coyote mexican restaurant on Beverly Blvd, Los Angeles 90036.
1743364.title: Amyl and the Sniffers Present: Truth or Consequence

1743661.synopsis: The Creator and Producers of DOLLY present their second anthology collection of horror short films including the cold open to A VERY LOVELY GIRL.
1743661.title: Horror Anthology Volume 2

1744007.synopsis: Earth's gravity weakens, causing devastating earthquakes and electric anomalies that magnetize objects to catastrophic effect. As the planet is ripped apart, a team of expert scientists must figure out the cause and save the world.
1744007.title: Geo-Storm

1744177.synopsis: The director sits down with her grandparents, Elenea and Manuel Papelera as they look back at what they remember about growing up at the end and post WWII in Philippines under Japanese occupation and how being raised in that environment has affected them and how they’ve gone about raising their family. From memories of their youth, to deciding to pick up their lives and immigrating their family to Australia, to working laborious jobs to provide for their family. After sitting down with her Lola and Lolo, the director uncovers her connection to her Filipino heritage. After strife over two countries and three generations her family is still here now, betting over Mahjong games against their friends.
1744177.title: Family Ties

1744681.synopsis: Three roommates borrow money from a dangerous lender to start a business. When their plan fails, they face serious consequences. Caught in a risky situation, they must use their wits to survive and fix their mistakes.
1744681.title: M.R.P (Neekentha Naakentha)

1744724.synopsis: Reflecting on his prolific, award-winning career in music and stage acting, Daniel Lavoie has no plans to slow down, with continuing performances around the world.
1744724.title: Daniel Lavoie: Failing at Retirement

1744734.synopsis: From Canada to Europe’s great opera houses, soprano Barbara Hannigan builds a fearless career defined by risk, precision and emotional intensity.
1744734.title: Barbara Hannigan: Soprano and Conductor

1744735.synopsis: Being together takes practice, and it's one of Sae Hoon (Stan) Chung’s favourite lessons from the arts community. It means letting go of the fear of having to try again.
1744735.title: Sae Hoon Chung: Worlding

1744737.synopsis: This short film is a reflective portrait of Tonya Williams, shaped through her encounter with her own archives. As she revisits these materials, Tonya recounts the memories that have anchored her journey.
1744737.title: Tonya Williams: One Way or Another

1744738.synopsis: Susan Benson: A Life in Form celebrates the work and career of the accomplished theatre designer through her reveries and reflections, revealing an artist still in bloom.
1744738.title: Susan Benson: A Life in Form

1744741.synopsis: James Cameron's driving force has always been curiosity. The director reflects on the spirit of exploration that inspired him as a child, in this film narrated by mentor and childhood hero Dr. Joe MacInnis.
1744741.title: James Cameron: Exploring Minds

1744876.synopsis: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.
1744876.title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song

1745638.synopsis: The stepping stone into the world of Abcounters  Many mysteries are yet to be solved. The clues have been given yet the story will be continued.  Sequel coming out soon…
1745638.title: Abcounters: The Origins

1745730.synopsis: Experience Lost Weekend in a breathtaking audiovisual journey that travels from the star-filled skies of Madagascar and the shimmering Northern Lights above Iceland's glaciers to the powerful storms across Texas. Filmed in nearly 20 countries, with no computer-generated imagery, this show brings audiences closer to the natural world through stunning nightscapes that blend music, science, art, and a sense of discovery.
1745730.title: Lost Weekend Planetarium Experience

1746179.synopsis: Unearthed from a landfill, a YouTuber discovers a sealed envelope marked "CONFIDENTIAL" - inside are four unmarked DVDs. Each disc reveals terrifying footage that was never meant to be seen. What he uncovers exposes a government cover-up too horrifying to ignore.
1746179.title: D/V/D-Redacted

1746508.synopsis: Echoes of Valor: WWII Veterans of Washington City, Utah
1746508.title: Echoes of Valor: WWII Veterans of Washington City, Utah

1746621.synopsis: The World has become a feeding ground for Vigilantes as the hospitals fill up with innocent victims to senseless crimes. A new drug called Paralysis has taken over a city that makes the user unusually violent during its high and a feeling of paralysis when coming down. A couple of cops make it their mission to take down the gang before their drug hits the streets any further. Time is ticking because the people of this city are fed up and are now willing to fight back. What will happen first, the cops take down the gang, the paralysis hits the streets creating a bunch of violent addicts, or will vigilante Justice take over. Paralysis is an action thriller with a twist that no one will see coming. All I know for sure is that this powder keg is about to explode in PARALYSIS.
1746621.title: Paralysis

1746767.synopsis: There's next level, the level after that, then there's Michael Crunch.
1746767.title: Michael Crunch

1747096.synopsis: After racking up $25,000 in fines due to her anger issues, a young woman enters a high-stakes pickleball tournament with her friends to win the cash prize, despite having no experience and facing a ruthless rival with a champion partner.
1747096.title: Pickleballers

1747262.synopsis: When a serial tickler terrorises the city, a hard-boiled police detective and his bumbling rookie assistant must discover the truth and put an end to the crimes.
1747262.title: The Man Who Tickles

1747277.synopsis: In search of inspiration, a handsome young artist who is struggling to animate their cute dog decides to watch a VHS copy of the cherished animated series Fred and Frank. When the VCR blows up, something crazy happens, but you'll have to watch the movie to find out, you cheeky sod.
1747277.title: Back to the Drawing Board

1747401.synopsis: Three children return home to visit their dying mother. The siblings argue endlessly over whether to remove life support, the inheritance, and matters of faith.
1747401.title: Xianglian's Room

1747451.synopsis: Across four worlds and centuries, ordinary people confront forces beyond their understanding as time, technology, fate and the supernatural reveal a hidden order governing reality.
1747451.title: The Hidden Order

1747643.synopsis: Two boys arrive at a remote summer camp in the Vermont woods. Free from screens and societal expectations, they learn to open up, support one another, and redefine what it means to be a boy. "Boys of Summer" is a tender vérité portrait of vulnerability, friendship, and the quiet rebellion of feeling deeply in a world that often tells boys not to.
1747643.title: Boys of Summer

1748404.synopsis: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.
1748404.title: Always Yours, Never Mine

1748879.synopsis: When Kaitlyn's neighbor retrieves a book of evil from the ocean, strange and sinister things begin happening in her quaint, Maine town.
1748879.title: The Ghastly Ordeal of Kaitlyn Krumdick

1749045.synopsis: Three years ago she stole a secret worth killing for. And now that she's back, this thief for hire has his own reasons for revenge. But just how far can he trust her?
1749045.title: Jinx

1749087.synopsis: A young corporate worker relocates to his village and works remotely. While there, he develops a passion for agriculture and applies his expertise to modernize farming practices.
1749087.title: Mr. Work from Home

1749166.synopsis: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.
1749166.title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan

1749286.synopsis: A priest has visions of turmoil.
1749286.title: Veil Of Apostasy

1749345.synopsis: States of Mind follows endurance athlete Lachlan Stuart as he attempts an extraordinary challenge: running 58 marathons in 58 consecutive days across every Australian state and territory and every U.S. state. Battling sub-zero temperatures, relentless fatigue and over 2,400 kilometres, the challenge pushes him far beyond his physical limits.  But this is more than a film about running. As the kilometres mount, Lachie and his wife navigate the emotional uncertainty of IVF, transforming a record-breaking feat into a deeply human story of hope, heartbreak and resilience.  Filmed with an intimate, observational approach by a minimal crew embedded in the experience, States of Mind places audiences alongside every step, revealing that true endurance isn't just about what we can achieve, but how we keep moving forward through life's greatest challenges.
1749345.title: States of Mind

1749456.synopsis: A former military sharpshooter turned nun breaks her vows when the woman she once loved falls into the hands of a ruthless crime boss. Armed with faith, a Magnum revolver, and jiu-jitsu, she wages a one-woman war for justice.
1749456.title: Mary Magnum: Jiu-Jitsu Nun

1749501.synopsis: A Christmas booking blunder in Frankenmuth, Michigan's beloved Bavarian village known for year-round Christmas charm, forces two families to share a B&B, where sparks fly, plans unravel, and romance sneaks in.
1749501.title: Romance in Christmas Town

1750165.synopsis: The 2026 NXT Heatwave was a professional wrestling television special and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the fifth annual Heatwave produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT and the 12th Heatwave overall. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right after Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's Ola de Calor event in the same venue.
1750165.title: NXT Heatwave 2026

1750432.synopsis: Spidey and the Avengers' Halloween plans are turned upside down by the mysterious Hallows' Eve, who plays magical tricks on trick or treaters and plans to ruin Halloween forever.
1750432.title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!

1750516.synopsis: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.
1750516.title: Pallaburusu

1750855.synopsis: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.
1750855.title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration

1751639.synopsis: Experience Sam Reid's electrifying live performance from the premiere event of Anne Rice's The Vampire Lestat at NYC's Beacon Theatre, featuring original songs by series composer Daniel Hart.
1751639.title: The Vampire Lestat: One Night Only Live

1751762.synopsis: A young trapper sets out into the mysterious Buckskin woods once explored by his father.
1751762.title: Buckskin 2

1751877.synopsis: Behind faded wallpaper and a red carpet hiding stains, a girl awakens into silence. She longs to escape; he longs to keep her. "Be My Darling" is a dark, unsettling vision where the fragile line between love and possession becomes a trap with no way out.
1751877.title: Be My Darling

1752138.synopsis: Successful event planner Bunmi longs for love and a family. Drawn into the seemingly perfect marriage of her neighbors, Bridget and Femi.When Bridget introduces her to her charming brother, Dexy, and draws her into a dark secret involving her husband, Bunmi is forced to confront the dangerous illusion of "perfect love," as she is caught in a web of deception where love, illusion and danger collide
1752138.title: Where is Mr Right

1752154.synopsis: Explore how sports, music, Broadway and comedy helped Americans rediscover joy and begin to heal in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.
1752154.title: 9/11: United We Stand -- 25 Years Later

1752159.synopsis: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.
1752159.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11

1752355.synopsis: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.
1752355.title: Schumacher ’94 – The Birth of a Legend

1752743.synopsis: Indie-rock group the Yeah Yeah Yeahs channel the spirit of David Lynch with this exquisitely ethereal, sublimely surreal record of a Los Angeles concert performance.
1752743.title: Yeah Yeah Yeahs: Hidden in Pieces

1752790.synopsis: A podcaster named Kevin Podcast unveils a sinister Hollywood conspiracy behind pipes hidden in hollow rocks across the world.
1752790.title: Pipe Rock Theory

1753447.synopsis: As Reese lives out his mundane office life, he starts to consider whether he is really making the most of his existence.
1753447.title: Shift

1753490.synopsis: Newly appointed PR Captains Rory and Joseph must work together to create the perfect student leadership council.
1753490.title: 2026 - 2027 Leadership Video Part 1

1753491.synopsis: In the second part of the leadership trilogy Rory and Joseph continue their journey to create the ultimate leadership council.
1753491.title: 2026 - 2027 Leadership Video Part 2

1753493.synopsis: In the epic conclusion of the Leadership Council trilogy, Rory and Joseph must find the final piece of the puzzle to complete their council and create the ultimate team.
1753493.title: 2026 - 2027 Leadership Video Part 3

1753554.synopsis: A lonely wife who can't seem to get her busy husband's attention falls for a man who stays in the same guest house. What she doesn't realize is that he set out to be there not for her.
1753554.title: The Random Guest

1753732.synopsis: When an unexpected visit from her remorseful ex interrupts a stressful evening at home, a young woman is forced to confront the seemingly unresolved feelings between them.
1753732.title: A Pale Visit

1753949.synopsis: During the Black Death, a hunted peasant named Frost fights to survive across plague-ravaged medieval England after a forbidden affair with a nobleman's daughter sparks betrayal, paranoia, and deadly pursuit.
1753949.title: Infectious

1754661.synopsis: Doctors rely on computer programs to make decisions about diagnosis and treatment. Designed to weigh factors like symptoms, medical history, and test results to achieve the best possible outcomes for patients, some common medical algorithms were built using data based on old pseudoscience about racial differences. Investigate how their continued use has harmed the health of Black patients.
1754661.title: When Machines Prescribe

1754785.synopsis: A man attempts to peer into a mysterious space beyond his limits.
1754785.title: in between

1754892.synopsis: Hosted by international Drag Race aficionado Angeria Paris VanMicheals, RuPaul’s Drag Race UK: Rewind takes a hilarious trip down memory lane to revisit some of the most unforgettable moments from seven seasons of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK and three seasons of RuPaul’s Drag Race UK vs The World. From iconic runway looks and legendary performances to outrageous comedy, unforgettable drama and the queens who snatched the crown, celebrate the very best of Drag Race UK — before a brand-new season begins.
1754892.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK: Rewind

1754906.synopsis: Between work shifts and concrete streets, a boy moves through a life that feels still and suffocating. An unexpected encounter fractures his routine and sparks a transformation destined to change the way he sees the world forever.
1754906.title: Disappear

1754940.synopsis: We follow Tallan Macdonald as he becomes “the Worst Underground Rage Rapper” in the world, through a series of interviews backed by friends, and footage of inspirations. The core message of the documentary will be to pursue whatever brings you the most joy, whether it may disturb or annoy others. The tone of the documentary is comedic, but will still include dramatic sections, and themes of coming of age.
1754940.title: 808s & BAD DECISIONS: THE STORY OF THE HOLDR

1755291.synopsis: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.
1755291.title: NAZA

1755665.synopsis: A notorious assassin captured by an AI-controlled covert Agency, must navigate fractured versions of his identities to reach the system's hidden cores-and destroy it from within before his secrets are extracted.
1755665.title: Assassin Within

1756138.synopsis: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.
1756138.title: Who Is Martin Mull?

1756234.synopsis: After being falsely accused of treason by a jealous king, the legendary warrior Alexander is exiled to a forbidden monster filled realm and tasked with an impossible challenge: slay three ancient Titans or die trying. Armed with a mystical medallion, a legendary sword, and the help of unlikely allies, Alexander embarks on an epic quest to save the woman he loves, reclaim his honor, and prevent a tyrant from seizing his kingdom.
1756234.title: The Odyssey

1756360.synopsis: Celebrating Dolly Parton's life, music and legacy -- featuring never-before-seen interviews with Dolly herself, unforgettable interviews with Robin Roberts and Barbara Walters, and reflections from those who knew her best.
1756360.title: Dolly Parton: An American Original – Special Edition of 20/20

1756450.synopsis: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.
1756450.title: The Last Salute

1756543.synopsis: British paranormal investigators explore a Hollywood mansion, uncovering true story of couple Daniel and Arthur, whose journey from homelessness to Hollywood history explores LGBTQ identity, resilience, and unexplained supernatural events.
1756543.title: Paranormal Hollywood Haunting

1756681.synopsis: A young woman is abducted and held captive inside a liminal room where she is trained to regress back into her primal, animalistic nature.
1756681.title: Animal Trap

1756786.synopsis: A documentary about the pioneers who helped bring Tibetan Buddhism to Australia and founded Chenrezig Institute, one of the first Tibetan Buddhist communities in the West.
1756786.title: Chenrezig Institute: The Origin of Tibetan Buddhism in Australia

1756792.synopsis: Experience intertwining stories of love, heartbreak, and redemption set in a charming Italian coastal eatery where strangers find unexpected connections through life's sweetest moments.
1756792.title: Slices of Love

1757068.synopsis: Chronicles comedian Dennis Miller's unlikely arrival in the "Monday Night Football" (MNF) broadcast booth in 2000, alongside veteran sportscaster Al Michaels and former NFL quarterback Dan Fouts. Intended to reinvigorate the iconic television franchise and attract a broader audience, Miller's addition, and his distinctly cerebral brand of humor, was met with both intrigue and skepticism across sports and television.
1757068.title: Miller Night Football

1757243.synopsis: Chaos seeps into a sleepy mountain lake town, as something sinister comes to the surface.
1757243.title: The Otherkind

1757386.synopsis: At the height of his career, Dane Cook wasn't just selling out arenas; he was redefining what a stand-up comedian could be. Then, in a shocking betrayal, the person he trusted most stole millions of dollars, forever changing his life. FUNNY MONEY: THE DANECOOK STORY is a gripping documentary about fame, family, greed, and survival, revealing the extraordinary true story behind one of comedy's biggest icons.
1757386.title: Funny Money: The Dane Cook Story

1757506.synopsis: Desperate people receive a mystical gift that grants wishes, collects souls, and creates monsters.
1757506.title: Crooked Miles

1757601.synopsis: Filmed live at Alexandra Palace on Saturday 25 October 2025.
1757601.title: Amyl and The Sniffers Live at Ally Pally

1758145.synopsis: On a quiet night, Sarah Mitchell, played by Karen Abercrombie, enters a dark church ready to end her life. Inside, Pastor David Reynolds, played by William L. Johnson faces his own loss of faith. Together, they confront hope.
1758145.title: Where Is Your Faith

1758536.synopsis: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.
1758536.title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part

1758620.synopsis: In the heart of Sydney, there is a forgotten street, which locals claim is haunted by past mysterious murders that occurred nearby. This film unearths a chilling question - are these murders mere coincidence, or is something more sinister.
1758620.title: The Street with No Name

1758630.synopsis: Blending verbatim performance with personal testimony, this film undertakes a creative exploration of the 2005 Cronulla riots, as well as unpacking our nation's continuing discussion around race and identity.
1758630.title: Twenty Summers Later

1758655.synopsis: In 1977 mafia-run Brier Hill, Youngstown, new lovers Benny and Taffy are driven by desperation into a spiral of vengeance and survival. As the streets close in, one irreversible choice seals their fate-and scars the neighborhood that raised them forever.
1758655.title: Brier Hill

1758773.synopsis: When his brother goes missing, Myles must confront himself to find him.
1758773.title: Scatterbrain

1759395.synopsis: 90s, in the middle of the night, while a narcissistic policeman and his clumsy intern stand guard on a street, a thief comes to completely disrupt their evening…
1759395.title: The Cops

1759852.synopsis: Marking two decades since the loss of a passionate wildlife conservationist, this documentary features rare footage and interviews with his inner circle, offering an intimate look at his journey, global legacy, and conservation mission.
1759852.title: Steve Irwin: A Wild Life

1760239.synopsis: When a mighty Dwarven warrior falls victim to a goblin's poisoned arrow, his weakling son must embark on a perilous quest to gather three ingredients needed to save his father's life before dawn breaks and all hope is lost.
1760239.title: Peter and the Goblin Arrow

1760262.synopsis: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One.
1760262.title: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane

1760485.synopsis: A mysterious man inhabits a home that is not his own. His true nature is revealed when nine different visitors come to the door one by one.
1760485.title: Shimmera

1760540.synopsis: After her break-up, on the day of her grandmothers funeral, Avery receives a brooch that allows her to travel through time.
1760540.title: Before It's Too Late

1760576.synopsis: Zakir Khan reflects on his childhood and the special bond he shares with his father, turning personal memories and family experiences into heartfelt comedy. With his signature blend of observational humour, poetry and emotional storytelling, he explores the unspoken sides of fatherhood and the relationship between a father and son.
1760576.title: Zakir Khan: Papa Yaar

1760638.synopsis: Searching for a missing friend, a group enters a dark forest and discovers an abandoned cabin concealing an ancient evil. As night falls, they must survive the shadows and uncover the truth before it is too late.
1760638.title: You Can't Leave

1762506.synopsis: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.
1762506.title: Band of Brothers: Legacy

1762763.synopsis: Before her death, activist Gloria Steinem shared her final, heartfelt message with the world, knowing this interview would not air until she was gone.
1762763.title: Famous Last Words: Gloria Steinem

1763033.synopsis: A young couple explores their relationship throughout three crucial moments in their lives
1763033.title: Nighthawks

1763496.synopsis: An exhausted nurse returns home to find her housemate refusing to let her in.
1763496.title: Got Off Early

1763619.synopsis: When the snobbish and wealthy AlThahabi family find out they're actually not as loaded as they think, they're forced to fake their affluence to survive.
1763619.title: Crazy Rich, Incredibly Broke

1763900.synopsis: "Cocaine" is a gripping crime thriller that delves deep into the murky intersection of law enforcement and criminality. Set against the vibrant yet perilous backdrop of Mumbai, the story revolves around a powerful drug cartel that wields significant control over the cocaine trade with the connivance of corrupt police officials and politicians. Abhimanyu Singh stars as Jalal, a diligent police inspector who finds himself entangled in the cartel's sinister web. Despite his best efforts to stay above board, Jalal must go to extreme lengths to protect his own brother, who is targeted by the ruthless cartel. As Jalal navigates the perilous dualities of upholding the law while safeguarding his family, he becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of survival.
1763900.title: Cocaine

1765072.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
1765072.title: You Can See Everything

1765336.synopsis: After war, Australian veteran Andy Fermo returned home carrying invisible wounds. Invisible Injuries explores PTSD's impact on identity, family and daily life, and the courage it takes to heal, reconnect and keep moving forward.
1765336.title: Invisible Injuries

1765627.synopsis: Celebrate the extraordinary life, timeless music, and unmatched legacy of a true global icon: Dolly Parton.  In this special 60 Minutes Australia anthology, we compile three of her most memorable and intimate profiles spanning 35 years.
1765627.title: Dolly Parton: A Life of Love

1765701.synopsis: A Lifetime original recounting the true story of Genelle Guzman, the last survivor pulled alive from the World Trade Center ruins after 27 hours. The biographical drama chronicles her harrowing experience during the September 11 attacks and premieres on September 12, 2026, to mark the 25th anniversary of 9/11.
1765701.title: Angel in the Rubble: The Genelle Guzman Story

1766051.synopsis: Private Investigator Donald Anderson is hired to follow a woman believed to be having an  affair, but when he sees something that defies all explanation, his grasp on reality slips. The  further he gets in his investigation, the thinner the line between the real and the surreal  becomes.
1766051.title: Gomorrah

1766245.synopsis: Before they can enjoy their afterlife festivities, the prideful Jade and her timid friend Elle must realise their deadly sins while confronting their romantic feelings for one another in an eccentric underworld.
1766245.title: After Party

1766609.synopsis: Built from an extraordinary archive - thousands of hours of raw home video footage shot across 35 years by DeSean's older brother Byron - this is an intimate, unfiltered portrait of a father and his two sons - their bond, their sacrifices, their conflicts, and their shared pursuit of a better life.
1766609.title: Go Deep: The DeSean Jackson Story

1766733.synopsis: The Responders: Breaking the Silence presents the untold story of September 11th, 2001 - both the uncensored accounts of those who risked their lives that day, and those who have since responded to the call to speak the truth, whatever the cost. Combining exclusive interviews with rarely seen archival footage, it is a saga of camaraderie, survival and courage in the face of overwhelming crimes.
1766733.title: The Responders: Breaking the Silence

1766752.synopsis: The tragedy of an elderly person’s self-inflicted end uncovers the hidden truth left behind in rural communities.
1766752.title: Black Goat

1767436.synopsis: When a covert black-ops contractor seizes Alcatraz, the CIA smuggles hardened agent Lt. Jack Callahan inside to extract whistleblower Anya Turner and her damning evidence before the mission spirals into a deadly fight for survival.
1767436.title: Escape at Alcatraz

1768182.synopsis: Misaki Yamada, 30 and single, has no clear ambitions. After drifting between jobs and places, she works as a care worker until trouble in love and work upends her life. Shiba, 38, avoids close relationships, but takes in his nephew and slowly bonds with him through Yamada. Shimizu, 46, faces caring for her father after years of putting work first. All three search for where they belong.
1768182.title: Dot to Dot: Will I Be Single Forever?

1768367.synopsis: Sam Morril delivers savage laughs as he relives his worst one-night stand, compares famous assassinations and details an unorthodox rat extermination.
1768367.title: Sam Morril: Incorrect

1768884.synopsis: Love, lust and infidelity. This story is about the little secrets that come along with it. An Australian suburban family face various dilemmas within and without their relationships, something many of us may not find so unfamiliar.
1768884.title: Dirty Little Secrets

1769361.synopsis: Biologist Joanne Chory is undertaking the final mission of her lauded career: supercharging crop plants to sequester carbon deep into Earth's soil, with the goal of cutting the pace of climate change in half. But she’s racing the two ticking clocks of ecological collapse and her own advancing Parkinson’s disease.
1769361.title: Plant Life

1770183.synopsis: Join the Doctor and Rose as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself.
1770183.title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit

1770295.synopsis: A documentary by ASA Australia. In this film, Australia's top 10 long-distance runners compete against World-Ranked junior marathoners at the Munich Marathon, Germany 2024 (10.5km x 4)
1770295.title: Forty-Two

1770314.synopsis: After losing a hand-me-down zippo lighter, Jackson spirals inward, retracing memories of his older brother he’s spent years suppressing.
1770314.title: Hand Me Downs

1770712.synopsis: Alex wakes up with a terrible case of "hangxiety," unaware his crazy night was caused by something far more paranormal… something his terrified friends know all too well.
1770712.title: Sunday Scaries

1770842.synopsis: Follows Four-time Formula 1 World Champion Max Verstappen who will take on 100 drivers in a unique go-karting event competition.
1770842.title: Max vs 100

1770849.synopsis: It's 1998. Deep in the pine forests outside a sleepy North Carolina town in Norton Creek, A loner has spent his whole life dreaming of being a killer. His only real friend is Dron, a towering, near silent, monstrous juggernaut. Together they cause destruction on locals, and a group of vampires passing by.
1770849.title: Norton Creek Massacre

1770859.synopsis: Jo Koy relives a wild dental disaster, recounts getting fired from McDonald's and celebrates his veteran stepdad in this hilariously heartfelt set.
1770859.title: Jo Koy: Blue in the Face

1770957.synopsis: In 1990s Punjab, Sukhman loses his beloved Dilruba after her family is murdered. Forced into marriage, he seeks the truth, only to discover a shocking secret.
1770957.title: Kankvanni

1771323.synopsis: After years of reporting on the scam industry, Mariana van Zeller enters one of her most immersive investigations to date. In a real-life social experiment, she builds a new online dating persona and goes undercover as the target of a romance scam to understand and expose the tactics, technologies, and psychological manipulations these criminals utilize to deceive their victims.
1771323.title: Super Scam Me

1771531.synopsis: Two friends enter Lahukheda, a village feared after dark, and uncover a chilling tale of dead spirits, revenge, and a terrifying truth hidden behind local legends.
1771531.title: Lahukheda

1771638.synopsis: A teen discovers a vintage camera filled with photos of her own escalating, deadly fate. She must find a way to fight the curse before time runs out.
1771638.title: Captured

1771803.synopsis: In a country where breast cancer is the second most commonly diagnosed cancer and the most common cancer among women, breast cancer is often seen as a success story, with the five-year survival rate sitting at over 90%. But until deaths stop, breast cancer is far from ‘solved’. Presenter Sue Collins takes the audience beyond these statistics to discover how remarkable Australians are changing the future of breast cancer.
1771803.title: Conquering Breast Cancer

1771844.synopsis: Seamlessly weaving through personal stories and stream-of-consciousness epiphanies, Kate Berlant offers up reflections on everything from the moon, to her destructive relationship to technology, to the evolving nature of sexuality.
1771844.title: Kate Berlant: Parmesan

1771989.synopsis: Two villages are bound by a rivalry that has outlived the men who started it. For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away. Left with nothing but the land beneath his feet and the promise he makes on it, he sets out to answer blood with blood. To bring his mother home, he must first confront the man who took her, and the price the soil demands is heavier than he knows.
1771989.title: Mitti De Putt

1772976.synopsis: When the McCurtain Gazette, a small family-run newspaper, begins reporting on alleged sex, drugs, and violence within the county sheriff's office, they find themselves the target of the sheriff's retaliation. Tensions escalate when the paper obtains a secret recording revealing the sheriff and local officials allegedly discussing having the family killed, turning a local investigation into international news.
1772976.title: Kill. Bury. Print.

1773496.synopsis: As Kaji steps into a new chapter of his life, familiar faces return while new characters enter his world, each bringing their own motives, desires, and complications. With new dreams and new responsibilities, Kaji finds himself facing challenges he never expected.
1773496.title: Kabaddi 5: After the Final Match

1773587.synopsis: When a young officer is murdered inside a general's home, a high-stakes investigation exposes a web of corruption and a cover-up reaching the highest ranks of the National Police.
1773587.title: General Mayhem: The Killing of Brigadier J

1773620.synopsis: A compilation of featurettes from the 2025 horror sequel, Five Nights at Freddy's 2. Including clips from the flim, behind-the-scenes footage, as well as interviews with the cast and crew.
1773620.title: Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 - Behind the Scenes

1773630.synopsis: After a suicide attempt, a fragile young woman awakens to find her boyfriend claiming her dead body is in their bathtub.
1773630.title: She Did It

1773759.synopsis: Dineo and Noni — besties meant to take on the party scene together — suddenly face their biggest fear when Noni's boyfriend spontaneously propose.
1773759.title: Seriously Single Too

1774055.synopsis: An aging political comrade leaves his career behind for marriage, only to find himself trapped in a chaotic, comical bind between two women and the bitter grudges of opposing political families.
1774055.title: Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2

1774588.synopsis: A Cold Ones animated short by Studio Goblin.
1774588.title: Mechamoefoe: Rise of Grogzilla

1775266.synopsis: Detective Marlene Morgan investigates 3 women, who suddenly disappeared without a trace.
1775266.title: Fridged

1775272.synopsis: Detective Tom Webourne isn’t your average rugged scrappy looking detective… He has  heightened senses. When the police stumble across a crime scene which they are clueless  about it’s the detective’s time to shine. Will he be able to shed some light and give the police  an idea of what really went down?
1775272.title: True Colours

1775352.synopsis: A young woman, Grace, escapes captivity and wakes with no memory. Detectives attempt to piece together who she is and why she was targeted, but get far more than they bargained for while searching for answers as Grace starts to relive memories without knowing if they're real or imagined.
1775352.title: Remembrance

1775802.synopsis: The traditional movie star is changing because constant access through platforms like Instagram has replaced Hollywood mystique with digital metrics like follower counts. Directed by journalist Kjersti Flaa, the 2026 documentary Social Media Killed the Movie Star explores how digital culture transformed celebrity.
1775802.title: Social Media Killed the Movie Star

1775866.synopsis: An inexplicable cosmic explosion separates a trainee aboard the Deep Space Station from Earth and their crew. Stranded alone in the depths of space, they must find a way home. But when all hope of communicating with Earth seems lost, a pair of brothers may hold the key to making contact once again.
1775866.title: Vacuum

1775891.synopsis: Two childhood best friends struggle to navigate brotherhood, betrayal, and redemption in the gritty and violent Mathare slums of Nairobi.
1775891.title: A Rough Sea

1775939.synopsis: A group of criminals known as The Hanover Gang rob and murder a rival gang. They hit the road and end up in a small seaside town called Luna Pier where they fall prey to a horrifying half-man, half-shark Nazi experiment.
1775939.title: Maws
