1776129.synopsis: A short film that captures a life-changing dilemma for a Mexican-American bride standing on the brink of traditional expectations. As Gloria prepares to marry her fiancé, Rodrigo, she is consumed by her secret, forbidden love for Emilia—a graceful, queer white woman who refuses to remain hidden in the shadows of heteronormativity. Through flashbacks to the night before the wedding, the film reveals the intense passion and friction between the two women. After an ultimatum from Emilia and a tense discovery by Gloria's sister, Sophia, the reality of their secret shatters the veil of the wedding festivities. Back in the present, Gloria faces a stark ultimatum: if she proceeds with the wedding, Emilia will leave to pursue a life of authenticity and freedom, fleeing the concealment of their relationship. As Rodrigo unknowingly waits at the altar, Gloria is left with the ultimate, breathless choice—honor her cultural tradition, or risk everything to follow a path of true self-discovery.
1776129.title: Gloria

1776531.synopsis: Revisits the bizarre nationwide hysteria of 2016, which began with reports of creepy clowns hiding near woods in South Carolina and quickly spiraled into widespread panic, school lockdowns, and police interventions across the United States. This in-depth documentary features interviews with eyewitnesses, law enforcement officials, cultural commentators, and professional clowns whose livelihoods were impacted by the craze.
1776531.title: Clown Panic

1776620.synopsis: In the Chicago suburbs, a community of passionate folks find connection and escape on the gravel courts of a local bocce league.
1776620.title: How We Roll

177677.synopsis: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet—eradicating 'The Syndicate', an International and highly-skilled rogue organization committed to destroying the IMF.
177677.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation

1777082.synopsis: Comedian Pandji Pragiwaksono turns spontaneous audience exchanges into an intimate and unpredictable crowd-work special.
1777082.title: Crowyokan

1777750.synopsis: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.
1777750.title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30

1778089.synopsis: After two hall monitors catch wind of a debaucherous high school party, they team up with an excommunicated popular girl to stop the party and save their classmates from ruining their lives.
1778089.title: Narcs

1780005.synopsis: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.
1780005.title: Surviving Hurricane Otis

1780339.synopsis: A feature documentary about five ordinary people rising from catastrophe to fight for the soul of their homeland. They are part of an unprecedented grassroots uprising—striving to defend democracy, end the bloodshed, bring the hostages home, and uphold Israel’s founding ideals of justice, equality and collective responsibility. In contrast to the headlines and the current extremist government, this film shows the true Israel, rooted in justice, pluralism and the search for peace. Whilst based in Israel, RISING is a universal story. With democracy under siege worldwide, RISING speaks to global struggles over authoritarianism, civic resistance and moral responsibility.
1780339.title: Rising: Voices of Protest and Hope

1780468.synopsis: Ben, a gifted skater with a crush on the school's queen bee, and Lionel, his bold but clueless best friend, chase popularity in their final year...until a run-in with a local drug lord makes them wish for their old lives back.
1780468.title: The Rough Patch

1781653.synopsis: Jamie Foxx delivers honest self-care comedy in "Take Care of Yourself." He joins the "Hularious" lineup with Hannah Berner, Ralph Barbosa, Bill Burr, Chris Distefano, Jim Gaffigan, Zarna Garg, Nikki Glaser, Ilana Glazer and more.
1781653.title: Jamie Foxx: Take Care of Yourself

1782745.synopsis: Alex is set to spend the summer in a seaside town. On the first day of his vacation, he feels lonely and bored, but he soon discovers that many new experiences await him.
1782745.title: Порив

1783228.synopsis: When a closeted Chinese-Australian cellist hijacks her family's Moon Festival to come out through song, her confession detonates buried secrets that force her entire family to choose between tradition and truth. Lydia, a reserved Chinese-Australian cellist, is harbouring a secret so terrifying it makes her physically sick-she's a lesbian, and coming out could get her disowned. When her father returns home from working overseas for the Moon Festival, her girlfriend insists this is her only chance, but Lydia is paralysed by fear. With unexpected support from her Spielberg wannabe younger brother, Lydia abandons her traditional cello performance to sing a raw confession to her entire family. Her coming out fractures the room-but more devastatingly, it triggers the revelation of another long-buried family secret.
1783228.title: Mooncake

1783629.synopsis: Michael Che takes aim at racism, marriage, free speech and everything in between.
1783629.title: Michael Che: Shot in Minnesota

1784507.synopsis: Basant Kaur dreams of representing India in kabaddi, but her life changes after she is sexually assaulted and later betrayed again. Pregnant and traumatized, she survives on the streets until her former classmate Fateh takes her home and cares for her and her newborn child. As Basant recovers her memories, she decides to fight for justice against those who harmed her.
1784507.title: Basant Kaur

1784646.synopsis: James Wylie's 2025 conclusion to the Time franchise, 'Saving Time', was a feature length motion picture released to critical acclaim.  But just what do the people behind the picture have to say about it? 'Iron Fisted Tyrant 2' is a documentary that asks the audience questions about power and control in the arts, the nature of adversarial relationships, and the strength of reconciliation.
1784646.title: Iron Fisted Tyrant 2

1786212.synopsis: Halloween's favorite tradition goes post-apocalyptic with the Hallowarrior filmmakers and their trove of Junk O' Lanterns.
1786212.title: Curse of the Ghoul Logs

1787183.synopsis: When Ruby Bridges Elementary opened in Washington State in 2020, its founding principal and staff made a radical choice: to educate every child in the same classroom, regardless of disability or support needs. Five years later, the school is seeing strong academic and social outcomes, without additional funding or staff. There was no magic fix – just a new model based on the belief that inclusion benefits everyone. All of Us is the story of a school that breaks the mold. A school that is unique, but shouldn't be.
1787183.title: All of Us

1788317.synopsis: Two humans spend an evening together where nothing is as it seems. They listen to some songs, chat and watch Deliverance (1972). A chicken is on the wall.
1788317.title: Slugtown

1788682.synopsis: Singlehood, relationships with parents and facing taboos — Sumukhi Suresh doesn't hold back as she tackles all this and more in her comedy special.
1788682.title: Sumukhi Suresh: Hoemonal

1788735.synopsis: After unexpectedly dying and being sent to Hell, Stewie and Brian’s constant nagging leads The Devil to quit, passing control of Hell to them.
1788735.title: Family Guy Happy Hell-o-ween

1789499.synopsis: Anaya awakes in the middle of the night and is entranced by the glow of the television screen.
1789499.title: Witching Hour

1789554.synopsis: Scene-stealer Mojo Brookzz unloads on freaky partners, wild BBL culture and his niece's big coming-out present in his debut Netflix special.
1789554.title: Mojo Brookzz: I Know You Lying

1789965.synopsis: The Last Treatment follows a renowned doctor trapped in a deadly night of crime, fear and impossible choices. As danger closes in, he is forced to fight for survival while facing revenge, sacrifice and painful decisions. Packed with action, suspense and emotional moments, the story explores a father's unstoppable love and the lengths he will go to protect those he cares for.
1789965.title: The Last Treatment

1790030.synopsis: When financial struggles threaten to close her family’s art-tour business before Christmas, self-taught artist Shelby Stevens enters a televised holiday painting competition, hoping the prize money can save it. During the competition, Shelby clashes with fellow contestant “Mark,” whose polished talent and charm slowly win her over through festive adventures and late-night creative breakthroughs. But when Shelby discovers Mark is actually Prince Henry of Serendovia, secretly escaping royal expectations to pursue art, their growing romance is put at risk. As Christmas approaches, Shelby and Henry must decide whether they are confident enough to paint a future of their own.
1790030.title: The Painter & the Prince

1790050.synopsis: Descendants. Zombies. And now, Camp Rock. Three fan-favorite worlds are finally colliding on one stage. Go behind the scenes of the "Worlds Collide Concert Tour" with hosts Trevor Tordjman and Jordan Clark as they get insider access hours before the doors open — seeing an empty venue transform into an all-new arena spectacular.
1790050.title: Disney+ Insider: Worlds Collide Concert Tour

1790725.synopsis: Two friends give up on revision in favour for a friendly game of Snakes and Ladders.  While playing the conversation that follows becomes as unpredictable as the game.
1790725.title: Snakes and Ladders

1790935.synopsis: Did AI just commit a felony? "Instadocs" investigates the Hugging Face hack and why this cyberattack may be a warning shot for humanity's future.
1790935.title: Instadocs: AI Gone Wild

1791327.synopsis: Suha, a content creator who had fallen into a rut, creating the same things day in and day out and repeating the same routine without any fresh inspiration. On a peaceful day like any other, while searching for inspiration, Suha is drawn to something. It is a waterfall. As Suha stares intently at a photo of the waterfall, something unbelievable happens.
1791327.title: Waterfall

1791376.synopsis: One year after surviving a Halloween massacre, Candee faces a new nightmare when a masked killer traps her and her friends inside a house where every secret is deadly. As the body count rises, she'll learn that the true monsters aren’t always the ones wearing masks.
1791376.title: Halloween Candy 2

1792142.synopsis: When two desperate university students, Timothy and Bryce, answer a Craigslist ad in the country for a sum of cash, their seemingly odd host shifts into something far more sinister, threatening their lives.
1792142.title: The Property

1792205.synopsis: The reclusive Jennifer grapples with a life tied together by a thread, when she begins to question the reality of the love between her and her boyfriend, Albert, things begin to gruesomely unravel...
1792205.title: The Girl With The Ribbon

1792938.synopsis: Bittu's peaceful life with his girlfriend Nimrat in Mumbai turns chaotic when his parents arrive unexpectedly. Unable to reveal their relationship, he introduces Nimrat as their housemaid. Their lie grows complicated when the male househelp falls for Nimrat and wants to marry her. As they struggle to keep their charade alive, family pressure and misunderstandings create chaos.
1792938.title: Meri Girlfriend Da Viyaah

1793193.synopsis: In 2020 a boy called Lukas found a magical 'Cloning Cloak' and cloned himself along with his best friend Muk, the cloning process how ever made backwards versions of each other. After Lukas and Muk got annoyed with their rude clones they both ran them over with Muks Mums car.  In 2024 Muk has a youtube channel and his video ideas are failing, so he digs up the corpes of his clone and reverse engineers the cloning cloak to bring him back to life. The cloning process like before didn't work properly, and now he has an evil clone who wants to take over the world, kidnap his cousin Jorge, and remake 2018 challenge videos.
1793193.title: The Clones 2

1794208.synopsis: A meditative reflection on the quiet absurdity of everyday life, exploring the fragile, fleeting connections that bind us within suburban spaces. Drifting through a series of surreal yet human moments, the film follows an ensemble of characters: two aging philosophers debating aliens from the depths of a kiddie pool, two pirates inexplicably destined for friendship, lovers attempting to reignite their spark through backyard karate, and a solitary dancer who dons a feline disguise to embrace his truest self.
1794208.title: It's Gonna Rain

1794216.synopsis: Two hapless weirdos join forces to search for their respective lost dogs, but all is not as it seems.
1794216.title: Lost Dog

1795934.synopsis: Comedian and chart-topping podcaster Theo Von returns to Netflix with his third stand-up special and his first in five years. The comedian opens up about the wild world that raised him, from his back-road upbringing to acid-filled adventures, in this revealing stand-up hour.
1795934.title: Theo Von: I'm Doing Fine

1796014.synopsis: Munro Logan And Emme Go To A Gig, The Gig  Afterwards Munro Realises His Friends Are Not Who They Claim To Be
1796014.title: Posers

1796219.synopsis: Oliver is an experimental musician struggling for recognition between his duties at home and at work. Spending more and more time on his strange music, he seems to have discovered an unexpected listener, one who may have a devilish motive.
1796219.title: Invite the Devil to Come and Play

1796638.synopsis: Coming up on the one year anniversary of her grandmother's passing, Taloa, a young, mixed-Choctaw woman, is still deep in the throes of grief. One night, a mysterious man steps in to help.
1796638.title: Song Bird

1796733.synopsis: Set in Salem, Massachusetts, in 1692, The Crucible follows a community thrown into chaos when a group of young girls are accused of witchcraft. At the centre of the hysteria is John Proctor, a respected farmer struggling with his past, his wife Elizabeth, and young girl Abigail Williams, whose accusations set the trials into motion. As fear, suspicion and personal vengeance take hold, the people of Salem must decide how far they are willing to go to protect their reputations and what they are willing to sacrifice for the truth.
1796733.title: Radford Theatre Company Presents Arthur Miller's "The Crucible"

1797190.title: A Life of Music - The Daniel Truhitte Story

1797200.synopsis: Celebrating their 10th debut anniversary, SEVENTEEN embarks on a world tour fueled by their determination for a fresh start, just like the title 'NEW_'. With their unrivaled stage presence and explosive energy, SEVENTEEN once again proves their unlimited potential. Experience the blazing heat of the concert—bursting with each member’s unique charm—right on the big screen!
1797200.title: SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR 'NEW_'

1797226.synopsis: The heat of cheering for HYBE artists unfolds in cinemas! Sing along with your favorite HYBE Artists in 3D! Join this unforgettable celebration filled with diverse music, passionate fan energy, and a dazzling wave of Light Sticks!

1797319.synopsis: Weeks before the holidays, a married couple decides to take a one-week break and spend Christmas apart, only for disastrous dates, family farms, and holiday magic to make them realize what they almost lost.
1797319.title: Single Before Christmas

1797363.synopsis: A couple's idyllic life at a secluded country home unravels as disturbing events uncover buried secrets-and a mysterious neighbor threatens to expose everything.
1797363.title: The Shadows of Trust

1797392.synopsis: For a generation of football fans, former Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Kordell "Slash" Stewart was one of the most electrifying players of the 1990s. But just as he became one of football's biggest stars, a malicious rumor upended his life. Through candid interviews with Stewart and others who witnessed his brightest and darkest moments, explore the personal toll of scrutiny beyond the football field while searching for the truth behind a story that followed Stewart for decades.
1797392.title: Kordell Stewart / Slash & Burn

1797507.synopsis: Two friends bonded through their love of the ocean attempt a world first: turn retired wind farm blades into surfboards. This experiment is then put to the ultimate surf test in the treacherous waves of the South Australian Eyre Peninsula.
1797507.title: Wind to Waves

1797639.synopsis: Sheriff Keith deals with Family relationships.
1797639.title: The good, the bad and the unattractive. The complete Trilogy.

1797674.synopsis: The cast upon the screen reflects only glare, but the audio that titillates the ears lasts forever. The films nature is that of a wistful melancholy, the art of longing for something no longer there. Virtual footage contrasts against blissful nature to appease the eyes in a profound... way.  "Cinema."  - Francis Carti
1797674.title: I Cling to Nothing But Everything Clings to Me

1797714.synopsis: A retired detective and his cousin launch a rescue operation when the detective's daughter is kidnapped by a trafficking ring, and law enforcement isn't doing their job.
1797714.title: Men of Law

1797756.synopsis: rare books, grindr, eggs. was that a wardrobe malfunction or a trick of the light?? #craigslist #highway61revisited
1797756.title: Summoning Bob Dyaln

1799441.synopsis: Ram and Godavari's childhood bond grows into love despite their villages' rivalry. After their friends face tragic consequences from family opposition, the couple must confront pressure and social divisions.
1799441.title: Kagitham Padavalu

1799458.synopsis: Former child soldiers and their rescued dogs learn to heal together.
1799458.title: The Comfort Dogs of Uganda

1799606.synopsis: After seemingly ordinary night of recreational drug use triggers a prolonged episode of derealization, Jordan's perception of reality unravels. Familiar places, loved ones, and even his own mind become frighteningly alien.
1799606.title: The Worst Week of my Life

1799907.synopsis: The artist Oliver Black wakes up and finds his wife dead next to him. Instead of calling for help, he hides the body and starts creating a death mask, before her face is lost forever.
1799907.title: Death Mask

1799919.synopsis: An action-packed sci-fi thriller that follows a team of time-traveling cops on a mission to stop serial killers in the past.
1799919.title: Interval

1801260.synopsis: When a group of friends arrives in the secluded town of Winchester for a wedding celebration, what begins as a weekend getaway quickly spirals into a desperate fight for survival. As people begin disappearing and the body count rises, they uncover a terrifying secret hidden for generations—one that binds the town's most powerful families to a deadly ritual.
1801260.title: Be Our Guests 2

1802058.synopsis: A celebration of the artist, songwriter, entertainer, humanitarian and entrepreneur whose music and generosity carried her from the mountains of east Tennessee into the hearts of generations around the world.
1802058.title: CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton

1802467.synopsis: After fiddling around with reality-hopping gadgets, good pals K and 907 embark on an alternate universe bender. The two quickly realise you can't enjoy a multiverse daytrip if you're sitting on unresolved conflict. How ruff.
1802467.title: K.907

1802674.synopsis: When a giant T-Rex threatens Hot Wheels City, it's up to Coop and his friends to race to the rescue and save the day.
1802674.title: Hot Wheels Let's Race: Attack of the T-Rex

1803141.synopsis: Trapped within a haunted house, a man finds himself at the mercy of two mischievous ghosts. Will he escape with his life?
1803141.title: Ghost Trouble

1803221.synopsis: Two critters work together to set a spinning window in motion.
1803221.title: Do You See What I See?

1803637.synopsis: In 1892 New England, a young woman constrained by Victorian society becomes the prime suspect in the brutal axe murders of her father and stepmother, sparking America's first celebrity murder trial.  More than 130 years after Andrew and Abby Borden were brutally murdered, their case remains unsolved. Lizzie Borden was tried and acquitted, but the mystery never ended. Now, this documentary reopens the case, reconstructing the timeline and re-examining the evidence, testimonies and suspects to uncover a darker possibility: what if the murders were not the work of one person, but a secret shared by the entire family?
1803637.title: Lizzie Borden: The Case Reopened

1804063.synopsis: A 17 year-old girl is going through a box of her late dad’s belongings with her best friend. Meanwhile, her mum struggles even to get out of bed. As Mia tries to distract herself from her grief, she becomes obsessive about going through the belongings.
1804063.title: Miscellaneous

1805769.synopsis: A chilling psychological thriller where a woman fleeing an abusive past moves across the street from a master manipulator. Blending domestic suspense with a "house of horrors" twist.
1805769.title: Man Across The Street

1806804.synopsis: Serial Killers rampage in a community riddled with corruption, leaving a team of hardened detectives as the only obstacle in their way.
1806804.title: The Abused

1807714.synopsis: An energised showcase of Yolngu culture, language + community, Dunganda Street Sounds brought together musicians living on + around Dunganda Crescent in Ramingining. With visual direction shaped by Jason Durrurranga + Michael Dawu, this proto-YouTube music video anthology sees boss men from Waak Waak Djungi guiding the next generations. Widely known across north-east Arnhem Land via its independent CD release, its film counterpart has rarely been seen in the years since + is shared here from project coordinator Allen Murphy’s digital archive.
1807714.title: Dunganda Street Sounds

1807728.synopsis: A group of travel journalist visit the quiet town of Willow Ridge to write a story about the Delaney family, known for their famous blueberry pies. But what they discovers during their stay will change everything.
1807728.title: The Seventh Day

1807748.synopsis: The 1965 Freedom Ride marked a turning point in the Australian civil rights movement when a group of 29 University of Sydney students, led by Charles Perkins, travelled through rural New South Wales to challenge racism and segregation against Aboriginal people. 7 of the Riders were Jewish, including future Chief Justice Jim Spigelman. Intimately observed by director Eliya Cohen, the film documents a commemorative journey in 2025, when Stand Up brought a new generation of Aboriginal and Jewish youth together to recreate the steps of the historic trip, building on the unique allyship between these remarkable communities.
1807748.title: Freedom Rides

1807926.title: LARA - The Man Who Took on Escobar

1808022.synopsis: The film juxtaposes footage of the cosmos, with fifties & sixties mechanical working, nature and technology.
1808022.title: Cosmic Mechanisms

180863.synopsis: After 20 years abroad, Mark Renton returns to Scotland and reunites with his old friends Sick Boy, Spud and Begbie.
180863.title: T2 Trainspotting

181808.synopsis: Rey develops her newly discovered abilities with the guidance of Luke Skywalker, who is unsettled by the strength of her powers. Meanwhile, the Resistance prepares to do battle with the First Order.
181808.title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi

181812.synopsis: The surviving Resistance faces the First Order once again as the journey of Rey, Finn and Poe Dameron continues. With the power and knowledge of generations behind them, the final battle begins.
181812.title: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker

185664.synopsis: A woman gets caught by the wife of her lover which results in a stabbing. Feeling guilty she runs away and joins a nunnery. But she soon discovers that several nuns and a well known author have turned the place into their own personal S&M playground.
185664.title: Nun in Rope Hell

188927.synopsis: The USS Enterprise crew explores the furthest reaches of uncharted space, where they encounter a mysterious new enemy who puts them and everything the Federation stands for to the test.
188927.title: Star Trek Beyond

192141.synopsis: In their new overseas home, an American family soon finds themselves caught in the middle of a coup, and they frantically look for a safe escape in an environment where foreigners are being immediately executed.
192141.title: No Escape

2005.synopsis: When lively lounge singer Deloris sees her mobster beau commit murder, she is relocated for her protection. Set up in the guise of a nun in a California convent, she proceeds to upend the quiet lives of the resident sisters.
2005.title: Sister Act

203801.synopsis: At the height of the Cold War, a mysterious criminal organization plans to use nuclear weapons and technology to upset the fragile balance of power between the United States and Soviet Union. CIA agent Napoleon Solo and KGB agent Illya Kuryakin are forced to put aside their hostilities and work together to stop the evildoers in their tracks. The duo's only lead is the daughter of a missing German scientist, whom they must find soon to prevent a global catastrophe.
203801.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E.

205775.synopsis: In the winter of 1820, the New England whaling ship Essex is assaulted by something no one could believe—a whale of mammoth size and will, and an almost human sense of vengeance.
205775.title: In the Heart of the Sea

206647.synopsis: A cryptic message from Bond’s past sends him on a trail to uncover a sinister organization. While M battles political forces to keep the secret service alive, Bond peels back the layers of deceit to reveal the terrible truth behind SPECTRE.
206647.title: Spectre

207703.synopsis: The story of a super-secret spy organization that recruits an unrefined but promising street kid into the agency's ultra-competitive training program just as a global threat emerges from a twisted tech genius.
207703.title: Kingsman: The Secret Service

212156.synopsis: A side story of the original Kara no Kyōkai - the Garden of sinners movie series divided into 2 parts. In the first part, Shizune Seo, who finds her life too predictable due to her precognition, and Mitsuru‎ Kamekura, who uses his precognition to be a professional bomber, meet Mikiya and Shiki, respectively, and their futures begin to change. In the second part, 10 years after the original series, Shiki and Mikiya's daughter, Mana Ryōgi, spends a day with Mitsuru.
212156.title: The Garden of Sinners: Future Gospel

216529.synopsis: A history of the ill-fated 1994 production of “The Fantastic Four” that was executive produced by Roger Corman.
216529.title: Doomed! The Untold Story of Roger Corman's The Fantastic Four

223485.synopsis: In the Old West, a 17-year-old Scottish boy teams up with a mysterious gunman to find the woman with whom he is infatuated.
223485.title: Slow West

227973.synopsis: Born loser Charlie Brown’s ordinary winter is turned upside down when the Little Red-Haired Girl arrives at school. Determined to impress her, the insecure and accident-prone Charlie Brown tries to become a winner through a series of hilarious attempts. Meanwhile, his loyal dog Snoopy takes to the skies as he writes a larger-than life story about his arch-nemesis—The Red Baron.
227973.title: The Peanuts Movie

228161.synopsis: When Earth is taken over by the overly-confident Boov, an alien race in search of a new place to call home, all humans are promptly relocated, while all Boov get busy reorganizing the planet. But when one resourceful girl, Tip, manages to avoid capture, she finds herself the accidental accomplice of a banished Boov named Oh. The two fugitives realize there’s a lot more at stake than intergalactic relations as they embark on the road trip of a lifetime.
228161.title: Home

228203.synopsis: A track coach in a small California town transforms a team of athletes into championship contenders.
228203.title: McFarland, USA

228205.synopsis: The lives of a young couple intertwine with a much older man as he reflects back on a lost love while he's trapped in an automobile crash.
228205.title: The Longest Ride

23202.synopsis: Four interwoven stories that occur on Halloween: an everyday high school principal has a secret life as a serial killer; a college virgin might have just met the one guy for her; a group of teenagers pull a mean prank, and a bitter old recluse receives an uninvited guest.
23202.title: Trick 'r Treat

23452.synopsis: Seven years have passed after the battle of Teppelin... Humans have since reclaimed the surface of the earth and enjoy an unprecedented period of peace and prosperity. However, humanity's increasing population growth triggers the sudden emergence of an unknown, powerful enemy. The fearsome, manipulative power of the mysterious Anti-Spiral proves too overwhelming for humans to even fight back. When everyone becomes desperate and loses hope, Team Dai-Gurren members reunite to stand up once again!
23452.title: Gurren Lagann the Movie: The Lights in the Sky Are Stars

238713.synopsis: A desk-bound CIA analyst volunteers to go undercover to infiltrate the world of a deadly arms dealer, and prevent diabolical global disaster.
238713.title: Spy

240.synopsis: In the continuing saga of the Corleone crime family, a young Vito Corleone grows up in Sicily and in 1910s New York. In the 1950s, Michael Corleone attempts to expand the family business into Las Vegas, Hollywood and Cuba.
240.title: The Godfather Part II

24128.synopsis: A concert film documenting Talking Heads at the height of their popularity, on tour for their 1983 album "Speaking in Tongues." The band takes the stage one by one and is joined by a cadre of guest musicians for a career-spanning and cinematic performance that features creative choreography and visuals.
24128.title: Stop Making Sense

24190.synopsis: A middle-class family flees an unspecified disaster that has struck the city and takes refuge in their country home. They think this will allow them to escape the chaos, but they soon realize that getting away won’t be so easy.
24190.title: Time of the Wolf

242141.synopsis: After a friend goes missing, an ambitious publicist begins investigating the exclusive society he longs to join. But a rat-masked figure starts stalking him, and as protests and political campaigns erupt, he begins to lose his grip on reality.
242141.title: Mousehead

245168.synopsis: Based on true events about the foot soldiers of the early feminist movement, women who were forced underground to pursue a dangerous game of cat and mouse with an increasingly brutal State.
245168.title: Suffragette

245698.synopsis: During the height of the Cold War, American chess prodigy Bobby Fischer finds himself caught between two superpowers when he challenges the Soviet Empire.
245698.title: Pawn Sacrifice

245703.synopsis: A father and son go on the run after the dad learns his child possesses special powers.
245703.title: Midnight Special

246655.synopsis: After the re-emergence of the world's first mutant, world-destroyer Apocalypse, the X-Men must unite to defeat his extinction level plan.
246655.title: X-Men: Apocalypse

24961.synopsis: Dorothy Gale, a shy kindergarten teacher, is swept away to the magic land of Oz where she embarks on a quest to return home.
24961.title: The Wiz

249688.synopsis: The story of the five-day interview between Rolling Stone reporter David Lipsky and acclaimed novelist David Foster Wallace, which took place right after the 1996 publication of Wallace's groundbreaking epic novel, 'Infinite Jest.'
249688.title: The End of the Tour

250124.synopsis: Minnie Goetze is a 15-year-old aspiring comic-book artist, coming of age in the haze of the 1970s in San Francisco. Insatiably curious about the world around her, Minnie is a pretty typical teenage girl. Oh, except that she’s sleeping with her mother’s boyfriend.
250124.title: The Diary of a Teenage Girl

250734.synopsis: In Victorian England, the independent and headstrong Bathsheba Everdene attracts three very different suitors: Gabriel Oak, a hardworking young sheep farmer; Frank Troy, a handsome and reckless Sergeant; and William Boldwood, a prosperous and mature bachelor.
250734.title: Far from the Madding Crowd

252451.synopsis: Join an American couple’s courageous mission in 1939 to help refugees escape Nazi-occupied Europe. Over the course of two years, the pair will risk their lives so that hundreds can live in freedom.
252451.title: Defying the Nazis: The Sharps' War

253331.synopsis: A grieving widower is drawn into a custody battle over his granddaughter, whom he helped raise her entire life.
253331.title: Black or White

253412.synopsis: Inspired by the incredible events surrounding a treacherous attempt to reach the summit of the world's highest mountain, "Everest" documents the awe-inspiring journey of two different expeditions challenged beyond their limits by one of the fiercest snowstorms ever encountered by mankind. Their mettle tested by the harshest of elements found on the planet, the climbers will face nearly impossible obstacles as a lifelong obsession becomes a breathtaking struggle for survival.
253412.title: Everest

254320.synopsis: In a dystopian near future, single people, according to the laws of The City, are taken to The Hotel, where they are obliged to find a romantic partner in forty-five days or are transformed into animals and sent off into The Woods.
254320.title: The Lobster

254470.synopsis: The Bellas are back, and they are better than ever. After being humiliated in front of none other than the President of the United States of America, the Bellas are taken out of the Aca-Circuit. In order to clear their name, and regain their status, the Bellas take on a seemingly impossible task: winning an international competition no American team has ever won. In order to accomplish this monumental task, they need to strengthen the bonds of friendship and sisterhood and blow away the competition with their amazing aca-magic! With all new friends and old rivals tagging along for the trip, the Bellas can hopefully accomplish their dreams.
254470.title: Pitch Perfect 2

254642.synopsis: On the 29th September 1945, the incomplete rough cut of a brilliant documentary about concentration camps was viewed at the MOI in London. For five months, Sidney Bernstein had led a small team – which included Stewart McAllister, Richard Crossman and Alfred Hitchcock – to complete the film from hours of shocking footage. Unfortunately, this ambitious Allied project to create a feature-length visual report that would damn the Nazi regime and shame the German people into acceptance of Allied occupation had missed its moment. Even in its incomplete form (available since 1984) the film was immensely powerful, generating an awed hush among audiences. But now, complete to six reels, this faithfully restored and definitive version produced by IWM, is being compared with Alain Resnais’ Night and Fog (1955).
254642.title: German Concentration Camps Factual Survey

256040.synopsis: The young Shivudu is left as a foundling in a small village by his mother. By the time he’s grown up, it has become apparent that he possesses exceptional gifts. He meets the beautiful warrior princess Avanthika and learns that her queen has been held captive for the last 25 years. Shividu sets off to rescue her, discovering his own origins in the process.
256040.title: Bāhubali: The Beginning

256514.synopsis: Based on a short story by Houshang Golshiri, this film centers on mysterious and chilling events that take place in a village. A group of superstitious inhabitants have erected a scarecrow for protection but soon find themselves terrorized by it. Made at the end of the Shah’s reign, the film offers a metaphorical reflection on power relations — how people create their own idols who turn around to terrorize them.
256514.title: Tall Shadows of the Wind

256591.synopsis: Nicky, an accomplished con artist, gets romantically involved with his disciple Jess but later ends their relationship. Years later, she returns as a femme fatale to spoil his plans.
256591.title: Focus

256924.synopsis: An ageing hard-living 1970s rock star decides to change his life when he discovers a 40-year-old undelivered letter written to him by John Lennon.
256924.title: Danny Collins

257094.synopsis: Teacher Nancy's life with her husband in Holland, Michigan, tumbles into a twisted tale when she and a colleague become suspicious of a secret.
257094.title: Holland

257211.synopsis: 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker has discovered that retirement isn't all it's cracked up to be. Seizing an opportunity to get back in the game, he becomes a senior intern at an online fashion site, founded and run by Jules Ostin.
257211.title: The Intern

257441.synopsis: Four people become trapped in the once-vibrant Rosemont Lodge during a blizzard before Christmas.
257441.title: Rosemont

25771.synopsis: British progressive rock band Pink Floyd perform at the ancient Roman Amphitheatre in the ruins of Pompeii, Italy in 1971. Although the band perform a typical live set from the era, there is no audience beyond the basic film crew.
25771.title: Pink Floyd: Live at Pompeii

258100.synopsis: APPROACHING THE ELEPHANT is a feature-length documentary about The Teddy McArdle Free School, where classes are optional and rules are made by democratic vote. Summerhill, founded 90 years ago by A. S. Neill, was the first free school - now there are more than 200 worldwide. Approaching the Elephant chronicles a free school in the making - spanning two years, from Teddy McArdle's first day when there were no rules or classes, through the changing of the school's director and the expulsion of a student by democratic vote, to the last day of the second year, APPROACHING THE ELEPHANT is an intimate portrait of a small group of people from a range of educational backgrounds, come together to forge a place where children are treated as equals, at liberty to spend their days however they please.
258100.title: Approaching the Elephant

258230.synopsis: 12-year-old Conor encounters an ancient tree monster who proceeds to help him cope with his mother's terminal illness and being bullied in school.
258230.title: A Monster Calls

258480.synopsis: In 1950s New York, a department-store clerk who dreams of a better life falls for an older, married woman.
258480.title: Carol

259316.synopsis: In 1926, Newt Scamander arrives at the Magical Congress of the United States of America with a magically expanded briefcase, which houses a number of dangerous creatures and their habitats. When the creatures escape from the briefcase, it sends the American wizarding authorities after Newt, and threatens to strain even further the state of magical and non-magical relations.
259316.title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them

259693.synopsis: Lorraine and Ed Warren travel to north London to help a single mother raising four children alone in a house plagued by malicious spirits.
259693.title: The Conjuring 2

259749.synopsis: The story behind the rise and fall of New York's 42nd Street. The cinemas, the films, the people, the crime and the rebirth of the block as "New 42nd Street" - this is the document of the world's most notorious movie strip.
259749.title: 42nd Street Memories: The Rise and Fall of America's Most Notorious Street

260513.synopsis: Elastigirl springs into action to save the day, while Mr. Incredible faces his greatest challenge yet – taking care of the problems of his three children.
260513.title: Incredibles 2

260514.synopsis: Blindsided by a new generation of blazing-fast racers, the legendary Lightning McQueen finds himself pushed to the brink—and suddenly, the champion who once ruled the track is fighting just to stay in the race. With his career hanging in the balance, McQueen must turn to an ambitious young race technician with a plan of her own, draw strength from the legacy of the late Fabulous Hudson Hornet, and risk everything on one last shot at glory.
260514.title: Cars 3

261023.synopsis: The true story of Whitey Bulger, the brother of a state senator and the most infamous violent criminal in the history of South Boston, who became an FBI informant to take down a Mafia family invading his turf.
261023.title: Black Mass

261860.synopsis: Behind-the-scenes documentary revealing what goes on inside the colourful, privileged, and sometimes stressful Christian Dior fashion house.
261860.title: Dior and I

262436.synopsis: A documentary about the sport of boxing, as seen through the eyes of champions Mike Tyson, Evander Holyfield and Bernard Hopkins.
262436.title: Champs

262973.synopsis: Madhumitha is convinced that she and her colleague Ashwin were lovers in their past lives and have been brought together by fate. Is there any truth to this or is she merely hallucinating?
262973.title: Anegan

263109.synopsis: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets a little more action than he bargained for. A mix up with the Farmer, a caravan and a very steep hill lead them all to the Big City and it's up to Shaun and the flock to return everyone safely to the green grass of home.
263109.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie

263115.synopsis: In the near future, a weary Logan cares for an ailing Professor X in a hideout on the Mexican border. But Logan's attempts to hide from the world and his legacy are upended when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dark forces.
263115.title: Logan

263172.synopsis: Truth and fiction collide when sexual obsession leads to betrayal. A voyage of discovery realigns subject, object and victim - things are not always as they seem.
263172.title: What I Have Written

263358.synopsis: An exploration of Jewish American identity in a multilayered portrait of the immigrant experience. A series of first-person addresses delivered by a cross-section of Jewish New Yorkers, whose by turns tragic and humourous tales speak to a collective history of trauma, displacement, and resilience.
263358.title: American Stories: Food, Family and Philosophy

263471.synopsis: A deformed hunchback kidnaps a bride and holds her hostage while his connection to her and his targets is revealed in a series of flashbacks that unfold as he starts seeking revenge.
263471.title: I

264038.synopsis: Two slum kids yearn to taste a pizza after being enticed by the pizza shop that has opened near their locality. What happens when they manage to find the money to buy one?
264038.title: Kaaka Muttai

26405.synopsis: A young schoolteacher descends into personal moral degradation after finding himself stranded in a brutal, menacing town in outback Australia.
26405.title: Wake in Fright

264164.synopsis: In a celebration of the trans community in Puerto Rico, the fissure between internal and external is an ever-present battle. A unique exploration of self-discovery and activism, featuring a diverse collection of subjects that include LGBTQ advocates, business owners, sex workers, and a boisterous group of drag performers who call themselves The Doll House, Mala Mala portrays a fight for personal and community acceptance paved with triumphant highs and devastating lows.
264164.title: Mala Mala

264644.synopsis: Held captive for 7 years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time.
264644.title: Room

264660.synopsis: Caleb, a coder at the world's largest internet company, wins a competition to spend a week at a private mountain retreat belonging to Nathan, the reclusive CEO of the company. But when Caleb arrives at the remote location he finds that he will have to participate in a strange and fascinating experiment in which he must interact with the world's first true artificial intelligence, housed in the body of a beautiful robot girl.
264660.title: Ex Machina

265339.synopsis: Ana, a nine year old girl, arrives with her mother to an isolated beach with the intention to rest and to know the sea. There, she discovers that they are under a terrible threat, therefore she is obligated to look for help with her father in order to save her mother.
265339.title: Ana and Bruno

266619.synopsis: A documentary about Caroll Spinney who has been Sesame Street's Big Bird and Oscar the Grouch since 1969. At 78-years-old, he has no intention of stopping.
266619.title: I Am Big Bird: The Caroll Spinney Story

268028.synopsis: An urban guerrilla, wounded after a bank robbery, seeks refuge with his childhood friend—only to discover that his friend has fallen into addiction. The guerrilla hides in his house and gradually begins to influence him, helping him regain his courage and strength. Eventually, he entrusts the stolen money to him…
268028.title: The Deer

268104.synopsis: An aging colonel retires, marries a provincial teacher, and moves to Tehran to be close to his two adult daughters. Instead of a peaceful reunion, he finds them living independent, urban lives he no longer recognizes. As the cultural and generational rift deepens, the family enters a tense, psychological spiral of alienation and emotional unrest.
268104.title: Tranquility in the Presence of Others

269149.synopsis: Determined to prove herself, Officer Judy Hopps, the first bunny on Zootopia's police force, jumps at the chance to crack her first case - even if it means partnering with scam-artist fox Nick Wilde to solve the mystery.
269149.title: Zootopia

269509.synopsis: An American family moves in to the Canterville Chase, a London mansion that has been haunted by ghost Sir Simon De Canterville for 300 years.
269509.title: The Canterville Ghost

270303.synopsis: A young woman is followed by an unknown supernatural force after a sexual encounter.
270303.title: It Follows

271110.synopsis: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.
271110.title: Captain America: Civil War

271674.synopsis: France, 1940. In the first days of occupation, beautiful Lucile Angellier is trapped in a stifled existence with her controlling mother-in-law as they both await news of her husband: a prisoner of war. Parisian refugees start to pour into their small town, soon followed by a regiment of German soldiers who take up residence in the villagers' own homes. Lucile initially tries to ignore Bruno von Falk, the handsome and refined German officer staying with them. But soon, a powerful love draws them together and leads them into the tragedy of war.
271674.title: Suite Française

271714.synopsis: In the late 1960s, the Beach Boys' Brian Wilson stops touring, produces "Pet Sounds" and begins to lose his grip on reality. By the 1980s, under the sway of a controlling therapist, he finds a savior in Melinda Ledbetter.
271714.title: Love & Mercy

271983.synopsis: Bruno is a young film editor who has just broke up his marriage with Regina, and returned living in his mother's house. Drowned in deep sorrow, something very weird happens in his life: people around him are gradually disappearing. But only for him. Some kind of blindness.
271983.title: A Man Amidst Bees

272693.synopsis: Bianca's universe turns upside down when she learns that her high school refers to her as a ‘DUFF' (Designated Ugly Fat Friend). Hoping to erase that label, she enlists the help of a charming jock and her favorite teacher. Together they'll face the school's mean girl and remind everyone that we are all someone's DUFF… and that's totally fine.
272693.title: The DUFF

272878.synopsis: A dog that helped soldiers in Afghanistan returns to the U.S. and is adopted by his handler's family after suffering a traumatic experience.
272878.title: Max

273153.synopsis: In 1971, a young woman moves from the French countryside to Paris and begins a passionate love affair with a feminist leader.
273153.title: Summertime

273248.synopsis: Bounty hunters seek shelter from a raging blizzard and get caught up in a plot of betrayal and deception.
273248.title: The Hateful Eight

273481.synopsis: An idealistic FBI agent is enlisted by a government task force to aid in the escalating war against drugs at the border area between the U.S. and Mexico.
273481.title: Sicario

273870.synopsis: Superstar Manoranjan learns that he has only a few days to live and approaches his mentor, director Margadarisi to direct his next project — a folklore-ish comedy about a man who keeps cheating death and his role in saving a kingdom. Meanwhile, he has to sort out his personal lives, which involves an estranged son and a daughter from the love of his life.
273870.title: Uttama Villain

274479.synopsis: A story based on the life of a struggling Long Island single mom who became one of the country's most successful entrepreneurs.
274479.title: Joy

274857.synopsis: When the child Arthur’s father is murdered, Vortigern, Arthur’s uncle, seizes the crown. Robbed of his birthright and with no idea who he truly is, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the sword Excalibur from the stone, his life is turned upside down and he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy... whether he likes it or not.
274857.title: King Arthur: Legend of the Sword

274870.synopsis: A spacecraft traveling to a distant colony planet and transporting thousands of people has a malfunction in its sleep chambers. As a result, two passengers are awakened 90 years early.
274870.title: Passengers

2759.synopsis: Two drag performers and a transgender woman travel across the desert to perform their unique style of cabaret.
2759.title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert

276907.synopsis: Suave, charming and volatile, Reggie Kray and his unstable twin brother Ronnie start to leave their mark on the London underworld in the 1960s. Using violence to get what they want, the siblings orchestrate robberies and murders while running nightclubs and protection rackets. With police Detective Leonard "Nipper" Read hot on their heels, the brothers continue their rapid rise to power and achieve tabloid notoriety.
276907.title: Legend

277216.synopsis: In 1987, five young men, using brutally honest rhymes and hardcore beats, put their frustration and anger about life in the most dangerous place in America into the most powerful weapon they had: their music.  Taking us back to where it all began, Straight Outta Compton tells the true story of how these cultural rebels—armed only with their lyrics, swagger, bravado and raw talent—stood up to the authorities that meant to keep them down and formed the world’s most dangerous group, N.W.A.  And as they spoke the truth that no one had before and exposed life in the hood, their voice ignited a social revolution that is still reverberating today.
277216.title: Straight Outta Compton

277834.synopsis: In Ancient Polynesia, when a terrible curse incurred by Maui reaches an impetuous Chieftain's daughter's island, she answers the Ocean's call to seek out the demigod to set things right.
277834.title: Moana

278193.synopsis: In the village of Plaachikkaavu, a local detective, Ujjwalan, must outsmart a mysterious figure in a deadly battle of wits, where his skills are put to the ultimate test.
278193.title: Detective Ujjwalan

278927.synopsis: After a threat from the tiger Shere Khan, Mowgli, a man-cub fostered by wolves, is forced to flee the jungle, and he embarks on a journey of self-discovery with the help of the panther, Bagheera, and the free-spirited bear, Baloo.
278927.title: The Jungle Book

279449.synopsis: Gopala Rao, an atheist, finds himself in the midst of crises. When Govinda Hari enters his home, Rao's life changes in miraculous ways.
279449.title: Gopala Gopala

280165.synopsis: An idealistic cop and an ambitious scientist-businessman indulge in a high-stake battle of wits.
280165.title: Thani Oruvan

280217.synopsis: It's been five years since everything was awesome and the citizens are facing a huge new threat: LEGO DUPLO® invaders from outer space, wrecking everything faster than they can rebuild.
280217.title: The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part

280583.synopsis: A young woman, and her last memories of the five people who loved her most, recalled while experiencing a catastrophic event.
280583.title: Violent

280996.synopsis: In 1947, long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.
280996.title: Mr. Holmes

281338.synopsis: Caesar and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless Colonel. After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the Colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both their species and the future of the planet.
281338.title: War for the Planet of the Apes

281957.synopsis: In the 1820s, a frontiersman, Hugh Glass, sets out on a path of vengeance against those who left him for dead after a bear mauling.
281957.title: The Revenant

283024.synopsis: A young woman is living with her mother at the end of a dead-end street. The young woman notices that a man standing in the street stares into her room every day. After a while, she gets used to his presence and falls in love with him.
283024.title: Dead End

283235.synopsis: After his family is evicted from their home, proud and desperate construction worker Dennis Nash tries to win his home back by striking a deal with the devil and working for Rick Carver, the corrupt real estate broker who evicted him.
283235.title: 99 Homes

283366.synopsis: A teenager finds himself transported to an island where he must help protect a group of orphans with special powers from creatures intent on destroying them.
283366.title: Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children

283552.synopsis: A lighthouse keeper and his wife living off the coast of Western Australia raise a baby they rescue from an adrift rowboat.
283552.title: The Light Between Oceans

283566.synopsis: In the aftermath of the Fourth Impact, stranded without their Evangelions, Shinji, Asuka and Rei find refuge in one of the rare pockets of humanity that still exist on the ruined planet Earth. There, each lives a life far different from their days as an Evangelion pilot. However, the danger to the world is far from over. A new impact is looming on the horizon—one that will prove to be the true end of Evangelion.
283566.title: Evangelion: 3.0+1.0 Thrice Upon a Time

283587.synopsis: Based on the experiences of Agu, a child fighting in the civil war of a West African country. Follows Agu's journey as he's forced to join a group of soldiers. While he fears his commander and many of the men around him, his fledgling childhood has been brutally shattered by the war raging through his country, and he is at first torn between conflicting revulsion and fascination.
283587.title: Beasts of No Nation

283591.synopsis: The hidden memoir of an elderly woman confined to a mental hospital reveals the history of her passionate yet tortured life, and of the religious and political upheavals in Ireland during the 1920s and 30s.
283591.title: The Secret Scripture

283708.synopsis: A French teacher in a small Algerian village during the Algerian War forms an unexpected bond with a dissident who is ordered to be turned in to the authorities.
283708.title: Far from Men

283984.synopsis: Ten years after the Fourth Holy Grail War, a devastating clash between Masters and Servants, another war erupts. Shirou Emiya, whose father fought in the first battle, was leading a peaceful life with the warmhearted Sakura Matou. But when hidden forces begin to stir, Shirou resolves to fulfill his father’s dying wish, protect Sakura, and fight for the Holy Grail.
283984.title: Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel I. Presage Flower

283995.synopsis: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.
283995.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2

284052.synopsis: After his career is destroyed, a brilliant but arrogant surgeon gets a new lease on life when a sorcerer takes him under her wing and trains him to defend the world against evil.
284052.title: Doctor Strange

284053.synopsis: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.
284053.title: Thor: Ragnarok

284054.synopsis: King T'Challa returns home to the reclusive, technologically advanced African nation of Wakanda to serve as his country's new leader. However, T'Challa soon finds that he is challenged for the throne by factions within his own country as well as without. Using powers reserved to Wakandan kings, T'Challa assumes the Black Panther mantle to join with ex-girlfriend Nakia, the queen-mother, his princess-kid sister, members of the Dora Milaje (the Wakandan 'special forces') and an American secret agent, to prevent Wakanda from being dragged into a world war.
284054.title: Black Panther

284303.synopsis: In the heat of the summer lays a lonesome house in the countryside where nine year old twin brothers await their mother’s return.  When she comes home, bandaged after cosmetic surgery, nothing is like before and the children start to doubt whether this woman is actually who she says she is.
284303.title: Goodnight Mommy

284689.synopsis: Testament of Youth is a powerful story of love, war and remembrance, based on the First World War memoir by Vera Brittain, which has become the classic testimony of that war from a woman’s point of view. A searing journey from youthful hopes and dreams to the edge of despair and back again, it’s a film about young love, the futility of war and how to make sense of the darkest times.
284689.title: Testament of Youth

285020.synopsis: Noel travels from upstate New York every year to sell Christmas trees in New York City.  Returning without the help of his long-time girlfriend, this year Noel finds it impossible to do the one thing he knows so well: sell Christmas trees. As Noel begins to spiral downwards, alienating co-workers and customers in the process, it turns out this same community of people may be the only ones capable of saving Noel from self-destruction.
285020.title: Christmas, Again

285203.synopsis: A film about the close relationship between two brothers. Markus (10) and Lukas (7) live in an old, yellow townhouse in the middle of Oslo. The river runs close to their home. A paradise in the heart of a big city. Here the brothers grow up with their dreams and longings for the future.
285203.title: Brothers

285783.synopsis: The story of French high-wire artist Philippe Petit's attempt to cross the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center in 1974.
285783.title: The Walk

286217.synopsis: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.
286217.title: The Martian

287499.synopsis: A rebellious young woman with cerebral palsy leaves India to study in New York. On her journey of self-discovery, she unexpectedly falls in love.
287499.title: Margarita with a Straw

287637.synopsis: Ayan, a pharmaceutical salesman in Pakistan, takes on the multinational health care corporation he works for after he realizes they knowingly marketed a baby formula that's responsible for the death of hundreds of babies everyday.
287637.title: Tigers

287947.synopsis: A boy is given the ability to become an adult superhero in times of need with a single magic word.
287947.title: Shazam!

289222.synopsis: The account of keepers of the Warsaw Zoo, Jan and Antonina Zabinski, who helped save hundreds of people and animals during the Nazi invasion.
289222.title: The Zookeeper's Wife

290098.synopsis: 1930s Korea, in the period of Japanese occupation, a new girl, Sook-hee, is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress, Hideko, who lives a secluded life on a large countryside estate with her domineering Uncle Kouzuki. But the maid has a secret. She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler posing as a Japanese Count to help him seduce the Lady to steal her fortune.
290098.title: The Handmaiden

290250.synopsis: A private eye investigates the apparent suicide of a fading porn star in 1970s Los Angeles and uncovers a conspiracy.
290250.title: The Nice Guys

290762.synopsis: The friendship between two life-long girlfriends is put to the test when one starts a family and the other falls ill.
290762.title: Miss You Already

291270.synopsis: An inspirational speaker becomes reinvigorated after meeting a lively woman who shakes up his mundane existence.
291270.title: Anomalisa

291537.synopsis: The world knows Paul Newman as an Academy Award winning actor with a fifty-plus year career as one of the most prolific and revered actors in American Cinema. He was also well known for his philanthropy; Newman's Own has given more than four hundred and thirty million dollars to charities around the world. Yet few know the gasoline-fueled passion that became so important in this complex, multifaceted man's makeup. Newman’s deep-seated passion for racing was so intense it nearly sidelined his acting career. His racing career spanned thirty-five years; Newman won four national championships as a driver and eight championships as an owner. Not bad for a guy who didn't even start racing until he was forty-seven years old.
291537.title: Winning: The Racing Life of Paul Newman

291549.synopsis: In Japanese-occupied Korea, three freedom fighters are assigned a mission to assassinate a genocidal military leader and his top collaborator. But the plan goes completely awry amidst double-crossings, counter-assassinations, and a shocking revelation about one of the assassins' past.
291549.title: Assassination

291805.synopsis: One year after outwitting the FBI and winning the public’s adulation with their mind-bending spectacles, the Four Horsemen resurface only to find themselves face to face with a new enemy who enlists them to pull off their most dangerous heist yet.
291805.title: Now You See Me 2

292011.synopsis: Richard Jewell thinks quick, works fast, and saves hundreds, perhaps thousands, of lives after a domestic terrorist plants several pipe bombs and they explode during a concert, only to be falsely suspected of the crime by sloppy FBI work and sensational media coverage.
292011.title: Richard Jewell

292081.synopsis: Documentary portrait of Carl Boenish, the father of the BASE jumping movement, whose early passion for skydiving led him to ever more spectacular -and dangerous- feats of foot-launched human flight.
292081.title: Sunshine Superman

292277.synopsis: A fresh perspective on a modern-day miracle that many of us take for granted: flying. Narrated by Harrison Ford and featuring an original score from Academy Award® winning composer James Horner, the film takes viewers to 18 countries across all seven continents to illuminate how airplanes have empowered a century of global connectedness our ancestors could never have imagined.
292277.title: Living in the Age of Airplanes

292391.synopsis: Set in the crumbling environs of Calcutta, Labour of Love is a lyrical unfolding of two ordinary lives suspended in the duress of a spiralling recession.
292391.title: Labour of Love

293167.synopsis: Explore the mysterious and dangerous home of the king of the apes as a team of explorers ventures deep inside the treacherous, primordial island.
293167.title: Kong: Skull Island

293646.synopsis: Based on the true story of the collapse of a mine in San Jose, Chile—that left 33 miners isolated underground for 69 days.
293646.title: The 33

293660.synopsis: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.
293660.title: Deadpool

293863.synopsis: After 29-year-old Adaline recovers from a nearly lethal accident, she inexplicably stops growing older. As the years stretch on and on, Adaline keeps her secret to herself  until she meets a man who changes her life.
293863.title: The Age of Adaline

293970.synopsis: A young woman grieving the loss of her mother, a famous scream queen from the 1980s, finds herself pulled into the world of her mom's most famous movie. Reunited, the women must fight off the film's maniacal killer.
293970.title: The Final Girls

294016.synopsis: The career of screenwriter Dalton Trumbo is halted by a witch hunt in the late 1940s when he defies the anti-communist HUAC committee and is blacklisted.
294016.title: Trumbo

294272.synopsis: For years, old wood carver Mr. Meacham has delighted local children with his tales of the fierce dragon that resides deep in the woods of the Pacific Northwest. To his daughter, Grace, who works as a forest ranger, these stories are little more than tall tales... until she meets Pete, a mysterious 10-year-old with no family and no home who claims to live in the woods with a giant, green dragon named Elliott. And from Pete's descriptions, Elliott seems remarkably similar to the dragon from Mr. Meacham's stories. With the help of Natalie, an 11-year-old girl whose father Jack owns the local lumber mill, Grace sets out to determine where Pete came from, where he belongs, and the truth about this dragon.
294272.title: Pete's Dragon

294963.synopsis: During a shootout in a saloon, Sheriff Hunt injures a suspicious stranger. The doctor's assistant, wife of the local foreman, tends to him in prison. That night, the town is attacked and they both disappear—only the arrow of a cannibal tribe is found. Hunt and a few of his men go in search of the prisoner and the foreman's wife.
294963.title: Bone Tomahawk

295592.synopsis: A newborn monkey and its mother struggle to survive within the competitive social hierarchy of the Temple Troop, a dynamic group of monkeys who live in ancient ruins found deep in the storied jungles of South Asia.
295592.title: Monkey Kingdom

295699.synopsis: A comedy that follows a group of friends as they navigate their way through the freedoms and responsibilities of unsupervised adulthood.
295699.title: Everybody Wants Some!!

296096.synopsis: Lou Clark, a directionless 26-year-old from the English countryside, takes a job at the local castle as a caregiver and companion to a wealthy young banker, Will Traynor. Wheelchair-bound from an accident two years prior, the once adventurous Will has all but given up — that is until Lou determines to show him that life is worth living.
296096.title: Me Before You

296098.synopsis: During the Cold War, the Soviet Union captures U.S. pilot Francis Gary Powers after shooting down his U-2 spy plane. Sentenced to 10 years in prison, Powers' only hope is New York lawyer James Donovan, recruited by a CIA operative to negotiate his release. Donovan boards a plane to Berlin, hoping to win the young man's freedom through a prisoner exchange. If all goes well, the Russians would get Rudolf Abel, the convicted spy who Donovan defended in court.
296098.title: Bridge of Spies

296449.synopsis: Master filmmaker Alexander Sokurov (Russian Ark) transforms a portrait of the world-renowned museum into a magisterial, centuries-spanning reflection on the relation between art, culture and power.
296449.title: Francofonia

296524.synopsis: A story set on the offshore drilling rig Deepwater Horizon, which exploded during April 2010 and created the worst oil spill in U.S. history.
296524.title: Deepwater Horizon

296917.synopsis: In a futuristic Japan, the Sibyl System is charged with keeping the peace. When the state of SEAUn brings the Sibyl System in to test its effectiveness, it becomes a haven of peace and safety—for a time. Eventually, terrorists from SEAUn begin appearing in Japan, somehow slipping through the System's security and attacking from within. Desperate for answers, Inspector Akane Tsunemori is sent overseas to bring the terrorists to justice. But when her investigation forces her into a standoff with an old ally, will she be able to pull the trigger?
296917.title: PSYCHO-PASS: The Movie

29698.synopsis: James Gillespie is 12 years old. The world he knew is changing. Haunted by a secret, he has become a stranger in his own family. He is drawn to the canal where he creates a world of his own. He finds an awkward tenderness with Margaret Anne, a vulnerable 14 year old expressing a need for love in all the wrong ways, and befriends Kenny, who possesses an unusual innocence in spite of the harsh surroundings.
29698.title: Ratcatcher

297556.synopsis: After the events of Justice League: War, Ocean Master and Black Manta have declared a war against the surface in retaliation of the aftermath of Apokoliptian-tyrant Darkseid's planetary invasion. Queen Atlanna seeks out her other son, Ocean Master’s half-brother Arthur Curry, a half-human with aquatic powers with no knowledge of his Atlantean heritage, to restore balance.  Living with powers he doesn’t understand and seeing the danger around him, Curry takes steps to embrace his destiny, joining the Justice League, and with his new teammates he battles to save Earth from total destruction.
297556.title: Justice League: Throne of Atlantis

297762.synopsis: An Amazon princess comes to the world of Man in the grips of the First World War to confront the forces of evil and bring an end to human conflict.
297762.title: Wonder Woman

297802.synopsis: Half-human, half-Atlantean Arthur Curry is taken on the journey of his lifetime to discover if he is worth of being a king.
297802.title: Aquaman

298382.synopsis: In 1950s Australia, beautiful, talented dressmaker Tilly returns to her tiny hometown to right wrongs from her past. As she tries to reconcile with her mother, she starts to fall in love while transforming the fashion of the town.
298382.title: The Dressmaker

298721.synopsis: In a hospital, ten soldiers are being treated for a mysterious sleeping sickness. In a story in which dreams can be experienced by others, and in which goddesses can sit casually with mortals, a nurse learns the reason why the patients will never be cured, and forms a telepathic bond with one of them.
298721.title: Cemetery of Splendor

299054.synopsis: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on and the skills to use them, The Expendables are the world’s last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table. But new team members with new styles and tactics are going to give “new blood” a whole new meaning.
299054.title: Expend4bles

299128.synopsis: An aspiring actress from Kansas comes to New York and meets a host of zany characters.
299128.title: Scarecrow in a Garden of Cucumbers

299534.synopsis: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.
299534.title: Avengers: Endgame

299536.synopsis: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.
299536.title: Avengers: Infinity War

299537.synopsis: The story follows Carol Danvers as she becomes one of the universe’s most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races. Set in the 1990s, Captain Marvel is an all-new adventure from a previously unseen period in the history of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
299537.title: Captain Marvel

300654.synopsis: Fourteen-year-old Mackenzie is sent to live with her uncle in Juneau when her mother can’t care for her anymore. The living situation quickly takes a turn for the worse, and she runs away to rejoin her mother in Seattle. While on her dangerous journey of sleeping in cars and breaking into hotel rooms, she’s drawn to Rene, a lonesome backpacker looking for tranquility in the wilderness.
300654.title: Wildlike

300668.synopsis: A biologist signs up for a dangerous, secret expedition into a mysterious zone where the laws of nature don't apply.
300668.title: Annihilation

300669.synopsis: A group of teens break into a blind man's home thinking they'll get away with the perfect crime. They're wrong.
300669.title: Don't Breathe

300671.synopsis: An American Ambassador is killed during an attack at a U.S. compound in Libya as a security team struggles to make sense out of the chaos.
300671.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers of Benghazi

300673.synopsis: The Coast Guard makes a daring rescue attempt off the coast of Cape Cod after a pair of oil tankers are destroyed during a blizzard in 1952.
300673.title: The Finest Hours

300687.synopsis: International art dealer Ron Hall must befriend a dangerous homeless man in order to save his struggling marriage to his wife, a woman whose dreams will lead all three of them on the journey of their lives.
300687.title: Same Kind of Different as Me

300693.synopsis: As a renowned producer and close associate of Dan Rather, Mary Mapes believes she’s broken the biggest story of the 2004 election: revelations of a sitting U.S. President’s military service. But when allegations come pouring in, sources change their stories, document authenticity is questioned, and the casualties begin to mount.
300693.title: Truth

300792.synopsis: An unlikely team of activists and innovators hatches a bold mission to save endangered species.
300792.title: Racing Extinction

301528.synopsis: Woody has always been confident about his place in the world, devoted to taking care of his kid—whether that's Andy or Bonnie. But after Bonnie creates a reluctant new toy called "Forky", a road trip adventure alongside old and new friends challenges everything Woody believes about loyalty, purpose, and what it truly means to be a toy.
301528.title: Toy Story 4

302104.synopsis: A woman struggling to meet airline baggage requirements meets a man who comes to her aid. They form a friendship that helps them mend each other's hearts.
302104.title: That Thing Called Tadhana

302401.synopsis: CIA employee Edward Snowden leaks thousands of classified documents to the press.
302401.title: Snowden

302528.synopsis: With the aid of a fellow Auschwitz survivor and a hand-written letter, an elderly man with dementia goes in search of the person responsible for the death of his family.
302528.title: Remember

302699.synopsis: Calvin Joyner, a mild-mannered accountant whose high school glory days are long behind him, reconnects with an awkward pal from high school through Facebook. After meeting up, Calvin’s mundane life takes an unexpectedly thrilling turn when he's thrust into the world of international espionage.
302699.title: Central Intelligence

302946.synopsis: As a math savant uncooks the books for a new client, the Treasury Department closes in on his activities and the body count starts to rise.
302946.title: The Accountant

302960.synopsis: It's one giant step for dog-kind as Scooby-Doo and the Gang blast off for an epic, other-worldly adventure in this all-new original movie! After winning the last 5 seats in a lottery, Scooby-Doo, Shaggy, Fred, Daphne and Velma are off to space in billionaire Sly Baron's brand new ship, the Sly Star One. It's all gravity-free fun until a mysterious alien begins destroying the ship! As the ship breaks down, the crew is forced to land on Sly Baron's base... on the dark side of the moon! Will the gang unravel this alien mystery? Will Scooby-Doo and Shaggy find snacks on the moon? Will Fred ever take his space helmet off?! Journey to the outer limits with Scooby-Doo to find out!
302960.title: Scooby-Doo! Moon Monster Madness

303857.synopsis: One peaceful day on Earth, two remnants of Frieza's army named Sorbet and Tagoma arrive searching for the Dragon Balls with the aim of reviving Frieza. They succeed, and Frieza subsequently seeks revenge on the Saiyans.
303857.title: Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection 'F'

303991.synopsis: An emotionally desperate investment banker finds hope through a woman he meets.
303991.title: Demolition

304357.synopsis: Maria Altmann, an octogenarian Jewish refugee, takes on the government to recover artwork she believes rightfully belongs to her family.
304357.title: Woman in Gold

306745.synopsis: New Jersey car mechanic Stacie Andree and her police detective girlfriend Laurel Hester both battle to secure Hester's pension benefits after she was diagnosed with a terminal illness.
306745.title: Freeheld

306819.synopsis: When Gerda Wegener asks her husband Einar to fill in as a portrait model, Einar discovers the person she's meant to be and begins living her life as Lili Elbe. Having realized her true self and with Gerda's love and support, Lili embarks on a groundbreaking journey as a transgender pioneer.
306819.title: The Danish Girl

306947.synopsis: Will and his new girlfriend Kira are invited to a dinner with old friends at the house of Will’s ex Eden and her new partner David. Although the evening appears to be relaxed, Will soon gets a creeping suspicion that their charming host David is up to something.
306947.title: The Invitation

307002.synopsis: A man suffering from insomnia is tricked into buying a drug, Lucia, that makes his desires come true in his dreams, blurring the line between fantasy and reality.
307002.title: Enakkul Oruvan

307081.synopsis: Billy "The Great" Hope, the reigning junior middleweight boxing champion, has an impressive career, a loving wife and daughter, and a lavish lifestyle. However, when tragedy strikes, Billy hits rock bottom, losing his family, his house and his manager. He soon finds an unlikely savior in Tick Willis, a former fighter who trains the city's toughest amateur boxers.
